tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// yan lag brgyad pa'i gso sbyong smyung gnas sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i phan yon mdor bsdus skal ldan ngal gso zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru lo ke shwa rā ya// rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas sku dang zhing*// gcig bsdus thugs rje'i ye shes tshad med pas// nam mkha' ji srid 'khor ba dong nas sprug /phyag na pad+mas byang chub bar du skyongs// 'jig rten mgon po snyigs dus gdul bya'i ngor// gang 'dul skur bstan dge slong dpal mo'i zhabs// srong btsan karma ka sogs rtsa ba dang*// brgyud pa'i bla ma snying gi ze'u 'brur bzhugs// srid mtsho'i sdug bsngal sgrol byed chos kyi gru// brgya lam rnyed dka' mdo sngags zab mo'i bcud// 'brel thob tsam gyis ngan 'gro'i sgo bcad pa// smyung bar gnas pa'i phan yon mdo tsam bshad// de la 'dir theg chen gso sbyong dang 'brel pa'i smyung gnas kyi cho gas 'phags pa sgrub pa'i thabs kyi phan yon mdor bsdus brjod pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bshad pa/ 'phros don cung zad brjod pa'o// dang po la'ang gzhi bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa/ de nyid theg chen gso sbyong dang 'brel pa/ smyung gnas dngos/ zhar byung gdan gcig 'chad pa ste bzhi las/ dang po la ji ltar ba srung ba'i tshul/ ma bsrung pa'i nyes dmigs/ bsrung pa'i phan yon no// de'i dang po la'ang gang gis srung na/ rab tu ma byung ba'i khyim pa pho mo thams cad kyis so// tshul ji ltar srung na/ dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gang rung ste sdom ldan zhig gi mdun nas skyabs gsum 'dzin pa sngon tu 'gro ba'i sdom pa'i tshig rnams rjes zlos lan gsum byas pa'i brjod pa tha mar sdom pa thob pas de nas brtsams sdom pa ma btang bar/ gnas skabs nad gdon rgyal po'i chad pa sogs kyi 'jigs skyob dang*/ lha ma'i bde 'bras la smon pa tsam gyi legs smon gnyis su ma song bar khams gsum las nges par 'byung nas myang 'das la dmigs pa'i bsam pas zin te dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi sgo nas bsrung ba ni phyi ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o// dus gang gi tshe srung na/

zla ba'i dus chen bzhi dang*/ zhag gi dus chen nya stong brgyad gsum sogs 'og tu 'byung ba'i dus 'gyur khyad can rnams la bab pa'am/ chos sems skye zhing mthun rkyen 'dzoms na de nyid du'ang rung ste/ mi'i tshe la nges pa med cing phyi bshol kho na chos kyi bar chad du che bas so// de yang nangs par zas ma zos pa'i gong skya rengs shar ba nas sdom pa blangs te sang skya rengs shar ba'i tshe bsnyen gnas gtong ba'i dus mtshams yin pas de bar nyin zhag phrugs gcig bsrung*/ cho 'phrul zla ba sogs kyi tshe lan grangs sbrel ba na'ang de ltar la len tshul gzhan nas gsal lo// gang bsrung bar bya ba ni/ yan lag brgyad la bsnyen par gnas pa ste/ de yang bsam bzhin tu srog gcod pa/ dngos po gang rung ma byin pa len pa/ bud med sogs la mi tshangs par spyod pa/ mi'i chos bla ma gtso bor gyur pa'i rdzun smra ba bcas rtsa ba bzhi spong ba tshul khrims kyi yan lag bzhi// myos 'gyur kyi chang spong ba bag yod kyi yan lag gcig /nyin gung yol nas ja sogs btung ba la rung chus shin tu sla bar byas pa ma gtogs dus ma yin pa'i kha zas bza' bca'i rigs gyur thams cad dang*/ cho ga dang ma 'brel bar rtsed mo'i phyir du gar rtse 1 glu len 2 rol mo 'khrol ba 3 gar sogs gsum/ 'phyor sgeg gis rgyan phreng 'dogs pa 1 smug rtsi sogs kha dog 'chang ba 2 lus gos dri zhim pa'i phyir spos byug pa 3 phreng sogs gsum/ chos 'chad pa po ma gtogs par rin po che dngos kyis sam/ gser shog sogs kyi rgyan spras pa'i khri dang*/ dar zab ther phrug gcan lpags rigs rin thang che zhing kha dog 'tsher ba'i stan te khri stan chen po/ khru gang las lhag pa'i mthon po brten pa bcas/ de ltar dus min gyi zas/ gar sogs phreng sogs/ khri stan che mtho gsum po spong ba brtul zhugs kyi yan lag ste bsdoms pas brgyad dang*/ jo bo rjes de steng gung tshigs dkar gsum kho nar spyod pa dang*/

bag yod kyi slad du chab len pa gnyis bsnan par mdzad do// gnyis pa ni/ srog gcod pas ngan song gsum dang khyad par dmyal ba yang sos su skye/ gal te mir skyes kyang tshe thung*/ gzugs ngan/ shes rab 'chal/ rtag tu skrag cing khro/ nad mang*/ mya ngan che/ dga' ba thams cad dang 'bral/ srog re re bcad pa la srog len dgu brgya go dgu nas sum brgya'i bar mchog dman la ltos pa 'jal dgos par gsungs/ ma byin pa blangs pas dmyal ba ngu 'bod du skye/ mir skyes kyang longs spyod cung zad kyang mi chags/ gsar du mi rnyed/ yod pa dang bral nas dbul/ gzhan gyis sdang zhing 'tshe/ mi tshangs par spyod pas ngu 'bod chen por skye/ mir skyes kyang skye ba lnga brgyar mdze mo dang dbang po ma tshang zhing mi sdug pa'i bud med dang ma ning kho nar skye/ nyer 'tshe dang dgra bo mang*/ rdzun smras pas thig nag tu skye/ mir skyes kyang ngag lkug /snying rje mi skye/ phrag dog che/ dri mi zhim/ skye ba kun tu chos kyi don mi go/ chang 'thung bas/ lcags zhun khol ma 'thung ba'i tsha dmyal du skye/ mir skyes kyang gnyid dang gti mug brjed ngas che/ blo gros dman/ 'jigs skrag dogs pa ldan/ phra ma mang*/ khrel dang ngo tsha med/ phrag dog dang ser sna che/ dge ba'i chos rnams nyams/ gnod sbyin dang khyi dang smyon pa rnams kyi skye ba lnga brgya re len pa dang*/ lnga ka'i thun mong du ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal lan grangs mang du myong ba sogs rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba zhes sdom pa zhus ma zhus gang gis spyod kyang nyes pa de dag myong ba ste/ sdom pa zhus nas mi dge ba de dag spyod na nyes pa 'bum 'gyur gyis che zhing*/ bka' 'das kyi ltung ba phog /phyi dro'i kha zas sogs la'ang nyes pa ches che ba mang yang smos kyis ma lang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ spyir rtsa bzhi chang lnga sogs mi dge ba spangs pas lha mi khyad par can du skye ba dang*/

srog gcod spangs pas tshe ring zhing nad med pa sogs gong gi nyes pa de rnams las ldog pa'i phan yon du ma thob tshul rgyas pa bslab pa lnga'i phan yon gyi mdor gsal la/ bye brag tu bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa dang 'brel ba'i phan yon ni/ gnas 'jog gi mdo las/ gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das/ 'di na gang skyes bu gnyis shig gnas mal gcig ni ji srid 'tsho'i bar du sbyin pa btang/ gcig ni yan lag brgyad pa'i bsnyen gnas la gnas na de gnyis bsod nams gang che bar 'gyur zhes zhus pas/ bka' stsal pa/ gnas 'jog 'di la 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa srung ba dang*/ sbyin pa gtong ba gnyis mnyam pa ma yin no// 'di lta ste dper na 'dzam bu'i gling na dgra bcom pa/ sems shin tu rnam par grol bar gyur pas gang ba de dag la/ gang la la zhig gis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ aṅga dang*/ kā shi la sogs pa'i yul chen po drug cu po rnams/ rdo rje dang*/ nor bu bai ḍūr+ya sogs rin po che'i rigs rnam pa thams cad kyis bkang nas brtson 'grus kyi stobs bskyed cing 'bul ba dang*/ gzhan yang chos gos dang*/ na ba'i gsos sman sogs yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa bas/ gang bsnyen gnas la lan gcig gnas na/ snga ma des ni bsnyen gnas las byung ba'i bsod nams kyi brgya yi cha dang*/ stong gi cha dang*/ dpe dang rgyur yang mi bzod de de ltar 'bras bu dang*/ mthu dang*/ rgya che ba yin no// gnas 'jog khyod 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i bsnyen gnas la gnas par gyis shig /cho 'phrul gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs la nan tan du gyis shig /lha dang mi'i spyad pa la longs spyod par gyis shig /ces gsungs pa de la dgongs nas dbyig gnyen gyis/ gang zhig dad pa'i sems kyis lo brgyar sbyin pa byin pa bas/ gang zhig nyin gcig tshul khrims srung ba'i bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ zhes gsungs shing*/

rgya mtsho chen po dang*/ gaṅgā la sogs chu klung chen po lnga yi grangs bum pas bzung bar nus kyi bsnyen gnas kyi phan yon ni tshad gzung mi nus pa dang*/ bsnyen gnas gtsang ma lan gcig gis rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha/ lan gnyis kyis sum cu rtsa gsum/ gsum pas 'thab bral/ lan bzhis dga' ldan/ lan lngas 'phrul dga'/ lan drug gis gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams su skye bar mdo de las gsungs/ gdams pa'i mdor bsnyen gnas lan gcig gis brgya byin tu skye ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod sogs mdo sde mang por skye ba kun tu ngan 'gro log par mi ltung*/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba dang 'phrad/ tshul khrims rnam par dag /de'i phyir smon lam gang btab 'grub pa sogs dang*/ da lta skyabs 'gro mchod 'bul bslab gzhi blang ba sogs dkon mchog la 'brel ba bzhag pas ma 'ongs rgyal ba byams pa'i 'dus pa dang por skye ba'ang byams pa lung bstan gyi mdo las/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang*// dri dang phreng ba byug pa yis// shākya thub pa mchod byas pas// nga yi bstan la lhags pa yin// gur gum chu yis gtor ba dang*// tsan dan gyi ni byug pa yis// shākya thub la mchod pa ni// phul bas nga yi bstan la lhags// rtag tu sangs rgyas chos dang ni// dge 'dun la yang skyabs song zhing*// dge ba'i las kyang byas pa ni// nga yi bstan la lhags pa yin// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// bslab gzhi yang dag blangs nas su// ji ltar gsungs bzhin bsgrubs pa ni// nga yi bstan la lhags pa yin// dge 'dun la yang chos gos dang*// zhal zas dang ni btung ba dang*// snyun gsos sna tshogs sbyin pa rnams// phul bas nga yi bstan la lhags// zla phyed kyi ni bcu bzhi dang*// bco lnga de bzhin tshes brgyad dang*// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla phyed la// yan lag brgyad la legs gnas pa'i// bsnyen gnas gso sbyong byas pas ni// nga yi bstan la lhags so gsungs// zhes gsungs pas de'i shugs kyis bde ba can sogs rang gang 'dod kyi sangs rgyas zhing du skye ba'ang bsnyen gnas bsrung pas 'grub pa gzhung gsal dang*/

lhas zhus pa'i mdo dang rtogs brjod gnyis kar/ bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang// tshes brgyad dang ni gnam stong la// bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa srung*// nga nyid ci 'dra de 'drar 'gyur// zhes dbang po brgya byin/ shā ri'i bu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis re re bzhin du gsungs pas lha dbang*/ dgra bcom/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang thob par bstan pa dang*/ kun tu rgyu sen ring gis zhus pa las/ srog gcod spangs pas rdo rje'i sku thob/ 1 de bzhin du ma byin len spangs sogs bdun pos rim bzhin phyag zhabs dra bas 'brel zhing gser 'khor rtsibs stong dang ldan/ 2 dbang po tshang zhing lus yongs su rgyas/ 3 ljags kyis zhal khebs shing gsung tshangs dbyangs dang ldan/ 4 tshems dkar mnyam bzhi bcu tshang zhing zas ro bro ba'i mchog tu 'gyur/ 5 tshul khrims kyi dri zhim po ldang*/ 6 mtshan bzang thams cad tshang*/ 7 chos bstan pa sum cu la longs spyod pa bcas dang*/ 8 mchod 'os la phyag byas pas gtsug tor ltar mi mngon pa thob pa bcas gsungs la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu'ang khang bu brtsegs pa'i mdor/ yan lag brgyad pa'i tshul khrims nyin zhag gcig srung na mtshon gyi bskal pa las thar/ gang gis dge slong la a ru ra rdog po gcig tsam phul na nad kyi bskal pa las thar/ gang gis zas nal bre gang tsam dge 'dun la phul na mu ge'i bskal pa las thar bar 'gyur bar gsungs/ gzhan yang phyi dro'i zas spangs pas tshe rabs gar skyes su lo legs/ bza' btung dang 'dod dgu 'bad med du 'byung*/ gar phreng spangs pas gzugs mdzes/ dri zhim dbang po tshang ba'i lus mchog thob/ khri stan che mtho spangs pas gzhan gyis bstod bkur che/ mal cha dang bzhon pa mang ba sogs phan yon rnam grangs du ma 'byung ba de rnams ni 'dir bstan so thar lugs kyi bsnyen gnas gtsang ma srung ba tsam kho na'i phan yon du shes par bya'o// gnyis pa bsnyen gnas de rgyud sde 'og ma rnams nas gso sbyong gi brdar bzhag pa'i theg chen sdom pa dang 'brel pa 'chad pa la'ang*/

srung tshul nyes dmigs phan yon no// dang po la'ang*/ srung ba po ni/ khyim pa dang rab byung gnyis kas so// srung tshul ni/ so thar sdom ldan gyi dge slong tsam gyis mi chog par 'di nyid kyi sdom rgyun bar ma chad pa zhig las thog mar sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir dang zhes sogs gzhung tshig dum bu bdun gyis bstan pa'i byang chub sems kyis zin nges par byas nas rjes zlos lan gsum gyis sdom pa blangs nas/ slar nam 'dod dus rten drung nas rang gis len pa sogs gzhung gsal ltar la/ sdom pa de so thar bcas rkyang min par theg chen so thar nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims yin pas/ yan lag brgyad ni nyin zhag sogs khas blangs rdzogs nas btang yang sems bskyed sa bon ni byang chub ma thob bar mi btang bas de nas brtsams rnam pa kun tu gzhan phan gyi sems 'ba' zhig dang mi 'bral bar bya'o// sdom pa 'di rgyal bu snying rje cher sems kyis ji srid 'tsho'i bar du blangs pa dkon brtsegs las gsungs pas de tsam mam lo zla ci rigs par blangs kyang chog pa'ang de'i shugs bstan tu snang ngo*// dus sngar dang 'dra/ bsrung bya rnam grangs gong ltar la 'dir ni theg chen gyi sdom pa'i khyad kyis yid kyi mi dge ba gsum gtso bo spong la/ lus ngag gi spang bdun zhar byung spong ba'i phyir/ srog gcod lta bu la mtshon na mi'am mir chags pa nas tha na grog sbur yan chad dngos su bsad pa lta ci smos/ ma mthong bar rdog pas brdzis pa'ang gti mug dbang las byung phyir bshags pa ma theng na sems can blos spong gi ltung ba 'byung ba sogs yan lag brgyad kar dngos dang phyogs gtogs phra zhing phra ba nas bsrung dgos la/ kha zas ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi zhun mar dang 'o zho chur khu ja rnams rung chus bslad pa de nam langs nas mun rub kyi bar bsten tu rung zhing*/ de 'phros gro nas 'bras sogs dus ma yin pa'i zas su gsungs pa de rigs nam langs nas nyin phyed kyi bar bsten/

de phan chad cung zad kyang bzar mi rung ba dang khyad par theg chen gso sbyong la ni/ sha khrag gi dri tsam yang 'dres mi rung ste/ glang po'i rtsal dang sprin chen dang*// mya ngan 'das dang sor phreng dang*// lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo las kyang*// ngas ni sha yang rnam par smad// ces gsungs pa ltar mdo sde de rnams su sha zos pa'i nyes pa dpag med gsungs shing*/ 'jam dpal gyi lta 'dod mdor bstan las kyang*/ rdzas thob don du srog gcod dang*// bza' ba'i don du rin 'jal ba// gnyis po dag kyang gsod pa ste// ngu 'bod la sogs rnams su 'tshed// gang tshe rdzas kyis sha nyos pa// khyim gnas rnams la sdig med na// de bzhin sku gzugs la sogs pa// byas na'ang ji ltar bsod nams 'gyur// gsod po nor la sred pa dag /bskal pa 'bum du 'tshed pa'o// za po sha la sred pa dag /bskal pa bye bar 'tshed pa'o// sha za ba yi mi gang zhig /dang po yi dwags 'gro ba ste// phyi ma ngu 'bod 'gro ba'o// zhes don bsdus su bstan cing*/ sha za'i dri tshor bas gnam sa bar gyi mi snang ba'i 'gro ba phra mo rnams shi la thug par brgyal zhing 'byung po rnams kyang dngangs pa dang*/ skye ba du mar mar ma gyur pa'i sems can ni mi srid pas ma'i sha za ba khrel che ba dang*/ bstan pa la mi dad cing skur ba 'debs pa'i rgyur 'gro ba dang*/ phra men lce spyang sogs skye gnas ngan pa du ma'i mthar ngan song du lhung ste/ mdor na sha za ba ni rgyal ba'i rjes slob min la/ rgyal ba nyid de'i ston pa min par gsungs shing*/ tsong sgog sogs la'ang nyes pa de dang cha 'drar snang bas bag yod gal gnad kyang zhar byung du 'phros pa'o// gnyis pa ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs gong du bstan pa des shes la/ khyad par byang chub tu sems ma bskyed na sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs ni 'ga' yang med pa gsung rab kun nas 'byung ba'i don bsdus mnyam med dwags pos/

gang la byang chub mchog gi sems zhig ma skyes na/ de ltar spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan yang theg pa chen po'i khongs su mi tshud la/ theg pa chen por ma tshud na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi thob bo// zhes gsungs/ gsum pa phan yon kyang gong gsal thun mong ba de steng*/ byang chub kyi sems skyes pas sdig pa myur du dag /tshogs yongs su rdzogs/ rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub nas ring por mi thogs par 'tshang rgya ba sogs dpag tu med de/ dpa' sbyin gyis zhus ba'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang*// gal te de la gzugs mchis na// nam mkha'i khams ni kun bkang ste// de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur// zhes dang spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams// skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg par byed// ces sogs rgya cher 'byung ngo*// gsum pa smyung gnas dngos la'ang bsrung tshul nyes dmigs phan yon gsum gyis 'chad pa'i dang po srung ba po ni/ spyir btang bya spyod nyams su len pa kho nas spyad byar yin rung*/ bye brag rigs kyi lha'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'i dbang du ni sus kyang rung ba dang*/ khyad par gangs can 'gro ba mtha' dag mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi gdul bya thun min nyid phyir/ lha de'i sgrub thabs dang 'brel bar ma ṇi 'don shes yan nas bla med kyi rnal 'byor pa man chad bye brag med par 'jug pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag bzhes te gdul bya 'dul thabs khyad par 'phags pa'o// srung tshul ni/ lha sngags gang yin de'i rjes gnang rigs gtad bklag lung tshang ma thob na rab/ tha na'ang de bzhin gshegs rigs la mi 'khrugs pa dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs la don zhags lta bu rigs kyi gtso bo zhig gi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa zhig ni nges par dgos la/

deng sang phal pa rnams smyung gnas sdod pa'i tshe na'ang bslab sdom sbyin pa gzhir bzhag nas skabs der rung ba'i phyir mdo gzungs kyi bklag lung*/ gzungs sngags ring thung gi rjes zlos lan gsum re thog mar bgyid bcug dgos/ phyin chad 'jug rung ba'i slad du smyung gnas grol ba'i nyin lha de'i rjes gnang zhig mdzad pa'ang phyag len no// dus ni gong smos lha sngags nyams su len pa'i tshe na'o// bsrung bya ni/ smyung gnas dngos gzhi'i nang mo nam langs nas bzung*/ phyir nang de tshod kyi bar nas 'bru chu thigs tsam yang bza' btung mi rung*/ gnyid dang glal ba sbrid pa 'og rlung sogs shin tu bsdam zhing*/ gal te shor na 'phral der gzungs chus nye reg bya/ bskyed rdzogs la blo mi nges pa rnams kyis rtog pa 'og 'gyu'ang shor mi rung bas dad 'dun snying rje sogs dge bsam la bsgril/ ngag gi gtam gleng sogs ci'ang mi rung ba ma zad bskyed rdzogs shes pa rnams kyis ngag smyung bar gnas pa zhes 'don pa'ang sgra bcas min pa'i yid 'don bya zhing phyag bskor sogs lus kyi ngal dub kyang spang ste lha sngags la rtse gcig tu gzhol/ bskyed rdzogs mi shes pa'am mi brtan na de ltar byas kyang tha mal du bsdad par 'gyur bas 'don brjod sngags bzlas phyag bskor sogs ci nus su 'bad/ rab byung rnams chos gos rnam gsum bgo/ gzhan dag kyang lpags rigs min pa'i gos gsar pa gyon/ nang snga yan lag lnga khrus gtsos nyi ma der khrus lan gsum bya/ phreng thag kyang ko thig min pa'i ras skud sogs la brgyus/ mdor na lus dka' thub/ ngag smra bcad/ yid rnam rtog gis ma bslad cing spyod lam gtsang sbra phul du byung bar bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ bya spyod nyams su len pa tsam gyis smyung bar ma gnas na mi rung ste lta sgom gyi grogs su spyod pa gzhung mthun tu spyod pa nyid de'i dam tshig tu gsungs shing*/

dam tshig med na chos kyi rtsa ba rul bas gsang sngags nyams su len pa skad byas kyang don 'bras mi 'byung zhing log pa'i rgyur 'gro ba dang*/ khyad par bza' btung dang smra ba mang pos rnam rtog rags pa spel/ des nyon mongs pa bskyed/ des ting nge 'dzin las su mi rung la/ lus ngag yid gsum smyung bar gnas pas sgo gsum gyi nyes ltung phal cher rang 'gag tu 'gro bar shes par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ spyir bshad ma thag pa'i nyes pa de ldog phan yon rnams thob cing*/ khyad par rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bsdus pa'i smyung gnas phan yon chen mo las/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis smyung bar gnas pa tshar gcig byas na bskal pa bzhi khri'i sdig pa dag cing lha mi'i mchog dam pa thob par 'gyur ro// smyung bar gnas pa lan brgyad byas na rgyun tu zhugs pa dang cha mthun zhing 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro// nyer lnga byas na lan gcig phyir 'ong ba dang cha mthun zhing bskal pa brgyad khri'i sdig pa dag par 'gyur ro// lan lnga bcu byas na phyir mi 'ong ba dang cha mthun zhing bskal pa khri phrag brgyad kyi sdig pa dag par 'gyur ro// smyung gnas tshar brgya rtsa brgyad byas na dgra bcom pa dang mtshungs shing bskal pa bye ba phrag brgya'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad dag par 'gyur ro// nges par 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du sangs rgyas tshe dpag med kyi zhabs drung du skye bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang lus smyung bar gnas pas srog bcad/ ma byin len/ mi tshangs spyod la sogs pa lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dag /yi dwags su mi skye/ nad gdon zhi/ gnas skabs su gzugs bzang gzi brjid che/ mthar thug mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku thob/ ngag smra ba bcad pas rdzun/ phra ma/ tshig rtsub/ ngag 'khyal sogs ngag gi sgrib pa dag /byol song du mi skye/ nus pa che/

gnas skabs su kha na ma tho ba dang ngag 'khyal mi 'byung zhing ngag tshangs dbyangs dang ldan/ mthar thug gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu thob/ yid ting nge 'dzin las ma yengs pas brnab sems/ gnod sems/ log lta sogs yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /dmyal bar mi skye/ nyams rtogs 'char/ gnas skabs su blo rno yid gzhungs chos kyi don go/ mthar thug ye shes lnga thob/ smyung bar gnas pa'i tshe rang lus tsha grang nad kyis nyen na dmyal bar skye ba'i las byang*/ bkres skom ngal dub kyis thang chad na yi dwags kyi skye sgo chod/ gnyid rmugs byings 'thibs dran pa mi gsal ba'i tshe blo gzengs bstod pas byol song du mi skye ba sogs rgya cher gsungs so// bzhi pa phan yon che zhing mchog dman sus kyang nyams len bde ba'i gdan gcig gam me gcig chu gcig tu grags pa ni/ srung ba po sus kyang rung la/ srung tshul rgyun ldan zhig las sdom lung nod de/ nyin gung du gong smos rung ba'i bza' btung rnams phud mchod changs bu sogs gung tshigs kyi bya ba dang 'brel bas ngoms par longs spyod/ de ma gtogs pa'i dus snga phyi nam du yang bza' btung ci yang mi byed par dge sbyor la 'bad pa'o// dus ni/ spyir zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i dus/ zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la sku bltams/ bco lngar mngon par byang chub pa'i dus/ 'ga' zhig gis brgyad la myang 'das kyi dus su'ang ngos 'dzin nas dus chen sum 'dzoms zer/ drug pa'i tshes bzhir chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus/ dgu pa'i bco lngar lha bab zhal bzhes dang nyer gnyis dngos te cho 'phrul chung ngu'i dus su grags pa bcas dus chen bzhi dang*/ yang brgyad du bzhed pa ltar na hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad nas bco lnga'i bar byang chub shing drung du bzhugs/ gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas brgyad kyi bar lhums su zhugs/

gsum pa'i bco lngar 'bras spungs su dus 'khor gsungs/ bcu pa'i tshes brgyad tho rangs myang 'das kyi dus te/ de rnams su dge sdig gang byas 'bum du 'gyur ba yongs grags dang*/ phal cher sa ya phrag brgyar 'gyur ba'ang gsungs/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes gcig la lha'i bu gzhon nu sems can rnams dge sdig ci byed nyul du mchi ste/ de'i nyin sangs rgyas ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mtshan nas brjod cing skyabs su 'gro ba dang sngags bzla zhing zas gcig pa srung na bskal pa bzhi bcu'i sdig pa byang*/ ral gri mdung thung gi dmyal ba las thar/ tshes brgyad la rgyal bu be con sems can rnams tshe ring thung nyul du mchi ste/ de'i nyin sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i mtshan brjod sngags bzlas sogs kyis bskal pa sum cu'i sdig pa byang*/ gcad gtubs dmyal ba las thar/ tshes bcu bzhir gshin rje'i 'khor dbang po 'char byed dge sdig gang byed yi ger bri bar nyul du mchi ste/ de'i nyin bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal bas bskal pa stong gi sdig byang*/ chu tshan khol ma'i dmyal ba las thar/ bco lngar lam rgyud lnga'i ded dpon tshangs pa kun rig sngar bzhin nyul te/ de'i nyin sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi mtshan sngags brjod pas bskal pa nyis brgya'i sdig byang*/ grang dmyal du mi skye/ bco brgyad la gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po dge sdig ci byed nyul ba'i dus te/ de'i nyin 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan dang sngags bzlas pas bskal pa dgu bcu'i sdig pa byang*/ ral gri gdong g.yang gi dmyal ba las thar/ nyer gsum la lha dbang phyug chen po nyul te/ de'i nyin sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi mtshan bzung bas bskal pa stong gi sdig byang*/ yi dwags su mi skye/ nyer bzhir gshin rje'i 'khor dbang po the'u shan nyul te/ de'i nyin byang chub sems dpa' sa yi snying po'i mtshan dang sngags bzlas pas bskal pa stong gi sdig byang*/

gcod cing gtubs pa'i dmyal ba las thar/ nyer brgyad lha'i dbang po brgya byin nyul ba'i skabs te/ de'i nyin sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi mtshan brjod pas bskal pa dgu bcu'i sdig byang*/ dmyal ba thig nag las thar/ nyer dgur phyogs skyong bcu nyul te/ de'i nyin sangs rgyas sman bla'i mtshan bzung bas bskal pa stong gi sdig byang*/ thal tshan me mur gyi dmyal ba las thar/ gnam stong la lha chen tshangs pa nyul du mchi ste/ de'i nyin rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i mtshan bzung sngags bzlas sogs kyis bskal pa stong gi sdig pa byang*/ zhib mor 'joms pa'i dmyal ba las thar ro// de rnams ni dmigs bsal gyi phan yon mdor bsdus te/ spyir sangs rgyas byang sems re re'i mtshan thos pa dang*/ ye ge drug pa lan gcig bzlas pa'i phan yon kyang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal dang rgyal sras rnams kyis brjod par mi nus par gsungs/ zas gcig pa lan gcig byas pas kyang tshe rabs thams cad du mu ge'i bskal pa las thar/ bskal pa khri'i bar du bza' btung longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ lha dang mi ma yin gyis skyob cing bya ba sgrub/ skyon thams cad dang bral/ tshe dpal bsod nams snyan grags 'phel/ mthar thug mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la reg pa sogs chos bzhin spyod na don chen 'grub pa chos kyi babs su snang bas lo rgyus rnying pa rnams su'ang*/ shan pa zhig gi gdan gcig lnga bcu byas pas mi dpon chos ldan tu skyes pa dang*/ mi drug g.yo sgyus bsad pa'i bud med zhig gis gdan gcig so dgu byas pas chos ldan gyi mi lus thob pa dang*/ yang bud med zhig gi gdan gcig nyer lnga bsrungs pas dge bshes tshad ldan zhig tu skyes pa sogs gtam rgyud spro bskyed mang du snang yang chos la yid ches zhig thob phyin chad de kho nas don tshang bas mang du smos mi dgos so// de rnams nyams su len tshul so so'i snying po sogs rgyas par gzhan du gsal ba ltar la/

mdor bsdus nang snga bar khrus dang gtsang sbra byas te sdom pa blang*/ bshes spring las/ rgyal bas sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// gtong dang tshul khrims lha rjes dran pa drug /rab tu bka' stsal de dag so so yi// yon tan tshogs kyi rjes su dran par bgyid// ces gsungs pa ltar skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa sngon tu 'gro ba'i/ mdun gyi nam mkhar tshes so so'i lha dang*/ bod spyi'i lha skal thugs rje chen po'ang chabs cig bsgom gal rgyal po bka' chems las gsungs pas tshes lha thams cad kyi g.yon tu 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi par bsgom nas de dag gi mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan brgya stong gang 'grub dang*/ so so'i gzungs sngags dang yig drug ci 'grub bzla/ sku gsung thugs las 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la phog pas sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ mthar snod bcud 'od du zhu lhar thim/ de yang dmigs med du bzhag nas dge ba bsngo/ de ltar thun bzhi'am drug gang 'grub 'bad/ nyin gung gdan gcig tshul bzhin bya/ sngon 'gro dang rjes bcas nyin phyed gnyis po'ang smyung gnas ltar thon na legs/ ma 'grub kyang nyin gcig po des 'thus la/ de ltar tshes gnyan so so'i nges pa sogs mdo sde las 'byung*/ gdan gcig dang yan lag brgyad po theg pa che chung gi bslab bya thun mong ba ste/ nyams su len tshul gyi go rim de rnams sprul pa'i rgyal po'i zhal gdams las 'byung ngo*// deng sang bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan la spyod pa'i dus mdo sngags zab chos kyi nges gsang bla na med pa rnams ni mos pa lam byed tsam las nyams su mi lon/ mthun rkyen tshang zhing rang dbang yod pa'i dus 'dir lam sna zin tsam zhig ma byung na ni rang gis rang bslus par gda' bas tshegs chung la don che zhing khe che la nyen chung ba'i chos spyod 'di 'drar tha na 'brel 'jog re tsam byung na snyam pas zhar 'phros su smos pa'o/// /

༈ rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa la'ang 'phags pa'i yon tan spyir bstan/ de'i sgrub thabs dpal mo lugs dang 'brel ba'i don khyad par du bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ces pa nyid don la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul gzhi ste chos sku'i ngo bo gzi brjid 'od dpag med/ longs sku nam mkha' rgyal po gangs chen mtsho// sprul sku rgyud pad+ma drwa ba las gsungs pa'i seng ge sgra sogs rigs bcu'i gtsos bye ba grangs snyed/ yang sprul bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas stong rtsa gnyis la sogs pa nam mkha' dang sems can gyi khams ji srid pa de srid du thugs rje'i 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa las sku'i ngo bo zhal bcu gcig pa/ gsung sprul yi ge drug pa/ thugs sprul ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ yon tan sprul pa rta mgrin/ phrin las sprul pa 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs dang sgrol ma dkar sngon rnams snyigs dus kyi gdul bya spyi dang*/ bod kha ba can 'dul ba'i lha mchog gtso bor gyur pa yin la de dag gi khungs spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyer gcig tu grags pa rnams las mtshan thos pa tsam gyis phan yon dpag tu med pa gsungs pa sogs smos kyis mi lang la/ mdor bsdus za ma tog bkod pa las/ rigs kyi bu gang nga 'dra ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams su gyur la/ de dag kyang gnas gcig tu bzhag cing na bza' dang*/ bshos dang*/ mal stan dang*/ na ba'i gsos sman dang*/ yo byad rnams kyis bskal par mchod kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i gsod nams kyi phung po bgrang mi nus na/ rigs kyi bu gang nga gcig pu 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na gnas pas lta ci smos/ gang 'jig rten na spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i ming dran pa de dag ni bde ba dang ldan pa yin no// de dag ni rga ba dang*/

na ba dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ sdug bsngal ba las yongs su thar pa yin no// de dag 'khor ba'i tha ma gzhan med pa'i sdug bsngal las thar bar 'gyur ro// de dag ni gos dkar po dang skya bo bgos bzhin du bya ngang ba'i rgyal po mgyogs pa dang rlung gi shugs 'ong ba bzhin du bde ba can gyi khams su de bzhin gshegs pa snang ba mtha' yas las chos mngon du nyan pa'i phyir 'gro'o// thos nas kyang de dag gi lus la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'byung*/ 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug mi 'byung*/ rga ba dang*/ shi bar mi 'gyur/ de dag gi lus la bgres par mi 'gyur/ mngal na gnas pa'i sdug bsngal ba shes par mi 'gyur te/ chos kyi ros bskyod nas de nyid du pad+ma'i nang du skye bar 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i yi dam brtan po yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad thar pa la bzhag gi bar du 'jig rten gyi khams de na rtag tu 'dzin cing gnas so// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang 'phags pa'i mtshan 'dzin pas gnas skabs su yang nad gdon me chu dgra rkun dug mtshon gcan gzan sogs 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug las skyob cing phan yon 'ga' zhig 'og tu 'byung la/ mdor na gong smos rgyal ba kun gyi sprul gzhi/ da lta'ang 'gro drug gi gnas rnams su tha na gru zam/ zas sman/ srin bu'i gzugs sogs gang la gang 'dul du sprul nas 'gro don rgyun chad med par mdzad bzhin pa ste/ mdo rgyud kyi phan yon ji snyed pa rnams 'phags pa'i yon tan kho na brjod pa dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa 'dir bstan dngos gzhi 'chad pa la/ phyogs gang du gtogs kyi khungs bstan/ brgyud pa'i rnam thar mdor bsdu/ sgrub dus bsnyen tshad spyir bstan/ phan yon rgyas par bshad/ rjes dam tshig bsrung tshul te sa bcad lnga yod pa'i dang po ni/ spyir spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo gzungs dang*/

bka' gter gyi rgyud du ma yod cing rgyud sde bzhi ka dang 'brel ba las/ 'dir bya rgyud la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rigs gsum/ 'jig rten pa'i rigs gsum ste drug yod pa'i snga ma pad+ma'i rigs su gtogs pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs la brten pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de yang 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal dngos kyis rjes su bzung ba ni dge slong ma dpal mo ste/ de ni o rgyan rgyal po'i sras mo zhig khyim kyi nyes dmigs mthong nas rab tu byung*/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas/ khrims shin tu btsun par bzhugs kyang sngon gyi las ngan smin nas mdze byung ste lus la na tsha dang sems la sdug bsngal drag po myong*/ phyag gnyis mkhrig ma nas chad de kha zas kyang bsnyabs mi shes par dud 'gro ltar gsol dgos pas/ 'khor rnams kyis bas mtha'i rtswa'i spyil po zhig tu bskyab nas bshum zhing bzhugs pa'i nub gcig rnal lam du/ rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis byin gyis brlabs shing 'phags pa sgrub na myur du mchog 'grub par lung bstan pa'i phyir nang nas zug rngu cung zad zhi ste/ nyin mo yi ge drug pa dang*/ mtshan mo gzungs ring thung bzlas/ lo rgyus kha cig tu kha sa ba ṇa'i nags su dpal gyi seng ge bya ba'i thugs rje chen po'i grub thob las 'di'i gdams ngag zhus nas de nyid du bsgoms pa'ang bshad/ gang ltar skabs shig tu sgrub pas sun nas thugs skyo ba na mnal lam du 'jam dpal gyis zhal bstan to// li khar shing 'phel du song la 'phags pa sgrubs shig /lo lnga nas rje btsun sgrol ma dang rtogs pa mnyam par 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ gnas der phebs pa'i lam du pad+ma mkha' 'gro bdun gyis phrin las zhus te/ shing 'phel rang byon 'phags pa'i drung du mchog ma thob par gdan mi spo bar dam bcas nas gdan gcig dang bsnyung gnas spel te 'jig rten mgon po'i bskyed rdzogs dang gzungs ring thung bzlas pas lo gcig nas snyun las grol/

ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma 'khrungs/ sku lus sor chud/ bdud dang phyogs skyong bcu sogs glags lta ba kun rje btsun gyi bskyed rim dang byams snying rje'i dam 'og tu chud/ klu chen brgyad kyis chos 'di'i srung mar khas blangs/ de nas dus lan gcig dge slong mas dgung lo nyer bdun bzhes pa'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes gcig la rje btsun sgrol mas zhal bstan/ sa dang po thob/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las khyod kyis byed par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs/ tshes brgyad la don zhags sogs kri ya'i lha phal cher zhal gzigs/ sa brgyad pa thob/ khyod kyis spyan ras gzigs kyi sgo nas 'gro ba thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'god par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs/ bco lnga'i nyin phyag stong spyan stong gi sku'i nang rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ ba spu'i bu ga re re la sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dpag tu med pa bkod pa gzigs pas lo bcu gnyis la dka' ba spyad pas de tsa na mi mjal ba'i yus gsol ba na/ khyod kyi sa dang po sgrub pa'i 'go brtsams nas 'bral med du gnas kyang da bar las sgrib ma zad pas ma mthong ba yin no zhes gsungs te chos bstan cing byin gyis brlabs pas sa bcu'i yon tan ma lus pa rdzogs/ 'phags pa dang gnyis su med pa'i go 'phang brnyes shing sku lus kyang gser gyi kha dog lta bur gyur to// de nas sngags spyod la zhugs pas mi kun gyis skur pa btab/ der ma dad pa bzlog pa'i ched du/ kha sab ṇa'i dus ston gyi khrom gseb tu rang gi dbu gri gug gis bcad de 'khar gsil gyi rtser bskyon nas nam mkhar sprin gseb tu gar mdzad/ slar sa la babs shing snga ma ltar sor chud pa mdzad pas der 'dus thams cad dad pa la bkod/ der spyan ras gzigs kyi rtogs pa gsungs pa tsam gyis de rnams dang*/ yul gru de'i pho mo thams cad kyis mchog gi dngos grub thob nas mkha' spyod du gshegs par grags so// de yang phyi ltar dge slong ma dpal mo/

nang ltar rje btsun sgrol ma/ gsang ba rdo rje phag mo dbu bcad ma dngos yin la/ in+d+ra bhu ti'i lcam lak+ṣ+mī ka ra dang gcig par yang bshad do// ༈ de yis rjes su bzung ba paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba gzhon nu ni/ rgya gar nub phyogs bram ze zhig tu 'khrungs/ sgra tshad sogs la mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab cing rab tu byung nas thos pa mang po'i don nyams su len pa na/ thugs rlung gi gegs shig byung ste ci byas kyang ma phan nas dge slong ma dpal mo mjal bar phyin pas byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis sos/ khyod kyis sngon bla ma zhig gi thugs dkrug kyang de'i bshags pa byas pas da res nad 'di byung zhing nga dang mjal ba yin gsungs/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i gdams pa gnang bas phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub de nyid du thob bo// ༈ paṇ+ḍi ta ye shes bzang po ni rgyal rigs rab tu byung ste rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa zhig sngon las kyis sku stod du rma srol chen po byung bar sman bcos du ma byas kyang ma phan/ lha 'dre'i gnod par dogs te grub thob zhig las gshin rje'i gshed kyi gdams pa zhus nas bsgoms pas sum logs kyis thur song*/ sku lus chu bur gyis khyab/ tsha reg zug rngu ma bzod par rdzing bur zhugs kyang drod kyis mtsho khol nas chu brje dgos pa byung*/ gnyan me dbal nag po zhes pa ste/ nus pa can thams cad la gtugs kyang ma phan par zla ba gzhon nu la zhus pas der 'byon par rtsom pa na/ rje btsun sgrol mas/ 'di ni bla ma zhig la dam nyams byas pa'i rnam smin yin te khyod kyis kyang gso mi nus pas dpal mo la gsol ba thob cig pa'i lung bstan byung ba ltar/ dge slong ma spyan 'dren gyi grogs mdzad de dpon slob gnyis mtsho khar phebs pa la gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs mdzad pa tsam gyis snyun gzhi med du dwangs/ dge slong ma bcu gcig zhal dngos su mthong*/ der spyan ras gzigs kyi gdams pa nyung ngu zhig gnang*/

rgyud sgrub thabs rgyas pa zla ba gzhon nu la zhus te zla ba gsum du smyung gnas mdzad cing bsgoms pas 'phags pa'i skur dngos su gyur te mchog thob bo// ༈ bal po paṇ+ḍi ta pe nya ba ni rgyal rigs mkhas pa'i phul du phyin pa zhig 'jam dpal gyis lung bstan nas rgya gar du byon/ ye shes bzang po la bcu gcig zhal gyi gdams ngag zhus nas lo lngar 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la bsten/ sgrub pa mdzad pas zhal mthong*/ mchog gi dngos grub thob ste 'ja' lus su gshegs so// ༈ de'i slob ma byang chub sems dpa' zla ba rgyal mtshan ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dngos yin par yongs su grags te mkhas pa dang grub pa brnyes pa mang po la spyan ras gzigs kyi lung bstan byung bas zhabs la btud pa'i lo rgyus du ma snang*/ nyid kyis skyid grong lo ke shwa ra'i drung du zhag bdun gsol ba btab pas/ long ba brgya la mig byin/ gtsug lag khang brgya brtsigs/ lam 'phrang brgya sol/ dge slong brgya'i 'tsho ba drongs phyag stong spyan stong la gsol ba btab pas de rnams 'grub ste myur du 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan thob/ der dge slong bzhi sde re khrid nas bsod snyoms mdzad pas sku bsod skyes te zang zing 'dus/ lha khang brgya lhag bzhengs/ srog bslu dang mig bslu sum brgya lhag mdzad/ lam 'phrang du ma gsos/ dge slong stong nyis brgya tsam de'i 'tsho ba sbyor ba sogs dge ba rlabs chen dpag med 'grub/ de'i tshe lho rgyud kyi grong zhig tu phebs pa na/ bud med nad ma zhig gis byin rlabs zhus par gtor ma dang bsngo ba yang mdzad nas/ na tsha sngon gyi mi dge ba las byung ba yin pas bzod pa dang byang chub kyi sems sgoms shig gsungs pas mo dad pa skyes te mchi ma blags bzhin tu/ tshe sngon ma lta zhog /tshe 'dir yang sdig pa mang du byas yod na zer bas/ 'o na sdig pa dran tshad mthol bshags gyis dang dag pa yin no gsungs/

der mo na re/ bdag skyid grong du tshong dpon phyug po zhig gi chung ma la phyin/ bu zhig yod pas lo bdun lon pa'i tshe/ tshong dpon bal yul du tshong la phyin nas lo gsum du ma 'khor/ shul du skye mched legs pa dang*/ nyon mongs drag po'i dbang gis skyes pa gzhan dang 'grogs pa'i bu zhig skyes pa de bsad/ longs spyod rnams kyang phyed med du song bas/ bu snga mas/ nga'i pha de byung dus khyod la ci 'dra zhig 'ong ngam zer bar/ ngas ci byas smras te rdog tho zhig brgyab pas mchin khar phog /kha nas khrag skyug ste shi/ der nga'i bu gza' gdong thug gis gum byas nas g.yo khram mang po lab/ bla mchod zhig la de'i rgyus yod pas de'ang dug blud nas bkrongs/ de nas tshong dpon nor dpag med bcas sleb pa na/ g.yog mo zhig gis lo rgyus rnams lkog tu bshad pas/ kho na re/ do nub mi shes pa ltar gyis/ nang par mig 'don no zer ba mos phag nyan byas pas tshor te 'jigs drag nas dug mang po chang la sbyar nas tshong dpon dpon g.yog brgyad/ khyim mtshes skyes pa gnyis/ khol mo gnyis bcas la blud pas de'i tho rangs nas smra mi nus par gyur te zhag gnyis kyi khongs su shi/ bdag lho bal du bros/ de'i le len bdas pas pha ming rnams kyang phung du bcug gzhan yang g.yo zol gyi sdig ci'ang bgyis na thugs rjes bzung 'tshal zer/ der byang chub sems dpas bud med cig la 'di 'dra'i sdig che ba dgongs te spyan chab mang po shor/ smyung gnas tshar gcig byas kyang ngan song du mi 'gro ba 'phags pa la dbu smyung bzhes pa yin pas 'di la de las drag pa'i re sa gzhan med dgongs te lung phog /smyung gnas tshar brgyad bgyid par bgos/ mo'i na ba'ang bla ma'i thugs rjes cung bde ba dang*/ sa ga zla ba la smyung gnas byas pa'i lan gcig gi dgong mor kha skom nas chang 'thung*/ yang lan gcig la ltog drag pas zhal zas bzhi phul yod pa'i gnyis zos/

de ltar smyung gnas hrul po lan gnyis dang*/ gdan gcig la brten pa'i bsnyen gnas drug ste/ brgyad tshar nas ring po ma thogs par shi'o// lan gcig byang chub sems dpas gtsang stod du sems bskyed zhig gsungs pa'i tshe mi thams cad kyis mthong bar tsi mar dngos su byung nas grub rtags zhig ston par zhus pas phyag mthil du spyan khra hrig hrig pa kun gyis mthong*/ kha cig gis bcu gcig zhal/ 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi pa/ kha sab ṇi la sogs dngos su mthong*/ kho yang dad de chos 'di'i srung mar khas blangs so// de'i tshe mi rnams shin tu dad nas sdig bshags phul pa mang po byung ba na dge slong zhig gis/ na ning rgan mo mi bco lnga bsad pa de shi bar thos pas gar skye zhus par/ zhal 'dzum mdzad de zhal bcu gcig pa'i smyung gnas 'di phan yon tshad med kyang nus pa shin tu nyung ba 'dug /bud med de rgya gar shar phyogs na bram ze 'byor ldan zhig gi bur skyes nas rin po che'i rgyan mang po can du gda'/ sngon smyung gnas byed po des mi lus thob kyang*/ kha skom nas chang 'thung bas shes pa mtho dman can/ zhal zas zos pas gzugs ngan pa zhig tu snang*/ skye ba der spyan ras gzigs la yi dam byed cing tshe 'phos ma thag tu bde ba can du skye bar 'dug /smyung gnas rnam dag tshar brgyad byas shing*/ 'phags pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa re brjod de phyag 'tshal na nges par bde ba can gyi 'jig rten du phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob cing*/ mthar byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur la/ lan gcig gis kyang nges par ngan 'gro'i sgo bcad par 'gyur/ chos 'di sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sgrub thabs yin pas kun gyis 'di la bslab par bya'o// zhes kyang gdams par mdzad do// ༈ grub thob nyi phug pa ni/ mnga' rir 'khrungs pa'i mtshan yid 'phrogs/ rab tu byung nas dgung lo nyer drug tshun la mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi grags pa thon/

der mnal lam du sgrol mas/ rigs kyi bu/ mar yul du spyan ras gzigs byon yod pas der song dang don gnyis 'grub par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i lung bstan ltar byon pas byang sems zla rgyas dang mjal/ phyag rten btang nas sgrub sla la don che ba/ ngan song dang gtan gyes byed pa'i chos shig zhu byas pas zhal bcu gcig pa'i gdams ngag gnang*/ bla ma'i bka' ltar byang phyogs dhā ki'i gangs su rtsam pa bre lnga la rlung non mdzad/ smyung gnas dang bcud len kho nas mi sus kyang ma tshor bar lo bdun bzhugs pas phyag mthil la nyi zer thol byung du 'char ba sogs 'byung bzhi dengs pa'i mtshan ma brnyes/ rta sgo'i lha btsan 'bum rjes chos skyong du khas blangs/ nam mkha' la 'phur te nyi phug tu phebs nas sprul pa'i bzo po du mas gtsug lag khang dang jo bo'i sku bzhengs nas gdan sa btab pas mtshan yang nyi phug par grags/ re zhig smyung gnas mdzad pa'i nam phyed spyan bud 'gro ba lta bu'i snyung zug byung bar/ mi dkar po zhig gis/ khyod kyi skye ba lnga brgya'i gong du rgya gar lho phyogs su mnyan par skyes te gru skya la nya po che'i mig bcar ba'i rnam smin gyi tha ma yin zer/ yang lan gcig zhal 'gram g.yas skrangs nas zug rngu'i mi bzod pa la'ang snga ma ltar/ skye ba dgu brgya'i gong du ma he'i 'gram pa rdos bcag pa'i rnam smin tha ma yin zer/ der 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ dus rgyun du smyung gnas kho na dang*/ sku khams ngan dus kyang dus bzang gsum la ma chags par gnang*/ skye ba de 'phos ma thag tu nub phyogs bde ldan gyi zhing du byang chub brnyes par lung bstan thob/ dgung lo don bdun bzhes pa'i tshes brgyad gcig la smyung gnas ngag bcad gnang bzhin nyi ma phyed yol du gshegs pa'i tshul bstan cing ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mtha' yas so// ༈ sru pa rdo rje rgyal po ni/ sru yul sgang du 'khrungs/

mtshan tshul khrims dkon mchog tu btags/ las sad de dgung lo bdun pa nas grub thob pa dang mjal/ rim par rab tu byung*/ theg pa rim pa gsum la mkhas shing btsun pa'i mchog tu bzhugs/ khyod mi gcig la chos gcig gis chog pa ster gsungs nas spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang gdams ngag gnang*/ ma shi'i bar du smyung gnas bgyid pa'i dam bca' phul te lo hril po lngar bcag mal gcig tu smyung gnas mdzad pas lo so drug tu 'gro ba'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la 'phags pa zhal gzigs te nyid kyi sku gsung thugs dang dbye ba med par byin gyis brlabs/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab/ 'tsho ba bsod snyoms kho na mdzad/ sha chang ljags thog tu bzhes ma myong*/ smyung gnas chags med du gnang zhing mthar sku gshegs pa'i gdung rnams ring bsrel du gyur pa mchod rten du bzhugs pas da lta'ang gsol ba btab na 'phel gdung 'byon par grags so// ༈ zhang ston dgra 'jigs ni/ khro phur 'khrungs pa'i tshe sa g.yo ba dang 'brug sgrog pa sogs kyis yab mes kyi dgra zhig yod pa 'jigs pas mtshan de skad grags/ rab tu byung nas sa skya sogs su lung rigs kyi grwa bskor mdzad pas mkhas pa'i snyan pas khyab/ bka' gdams kyi rnam thar shin tu gtsang zhing grwa ba lnga brgya tsam 'dus pa'i chos sde skyong ba la sgrol mas lung bstan te/ byang sems gru ba'i drung nas zhal bcu gcig pa'i gdams skor zhus/ smyung gnas mdzad nas lo gsum dang zla ba bzhi song ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nub kyi cha dang por sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyer gcig /gnyis par sman bla mched brgyad/ gsum par 'phags pa la bya spyod kyi lha mang pos bskor ba zhal gzigs/ dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ bu khyod kha zas dang gshin zas ma za bar ri khrod dben pa bsten la nus na bcud len gyis/ mi nus na bsod snyoms gyis la sems can gyi don mdzod ces lung bstan/

des bla ma'i bka' ltar gad na sa lo gsum mdzad grub 'phral na bza' dang bzhugs gdan yod pa spangs dag mdzad/ lung pa'i phu rdza gseb zhig tu sus kyang ma mthong bar smyung gnas zla ba gsum mdzad pas tshad nad drag po zhag bdun tu byung ste/ da rang shi'am snyam pa na tho rangs mnal za zi zhig la spyan ras gzigs kyis/ khyod kyi skye ba mang po'i gong rgya gar du gang zhig la skyes te nya rnams gson por chu tshan tu btsos nas zos pas chu tshan khol ma'i dmyal bar lo grangs dung phyur sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshe bdag gi 'od kyis reg pas mir skyes nas skye ba bcu drug brgyud pa'i tshe nga la 'brel ba bzhag pas da res rjes su bzung zhing nad 'dis sgrib pa'i lhag ma dag pa yin gsungs te phyag gis byab pas snyun las grol/ de nas kyang dka' ba spyad drag pas rlung langs te zhag bdun tu thugs dran ma byung ba la spen ma'i thal ba chur bskol ba dang*/ res za tshod/ res lug rdzi'i snab lud skam pos kyang rlung non mdzad/ chu thigs gcig kyang ma gsol bar zla ba bdun bzhugs pa sogs lo gsum la dka' ba spyad nas 'phags pa'i bskyed rdzogs bsgoms pas grub pa brnyes te mkha' la 'phur ba dang*/ chu bo gyen du zlog pa sogs rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung du ma bstan/ gshegs pa'i tshe ring bsrel bre do dang thugs ljags byon pa gdung rten gnyis su bzhugs so// ༈ byang pa mkhan chen rtsi 'dul ba ni/ gzhon nu nas rab tu byung zhing byams chos gtso bor gyur pa'i chos la sbyangs pa shin tu che bas mkhas shing btsun pa'i mthar thug /mtshan thugs rje byang chub tu grags/ tshul khrims kyi dri dro lam rer khyab/ sku bsod che bas grwa ba stong phrag re 'dus pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa sogs dge ba rlabs chen du ma mdzad/ sgrol mas lung bstan pa ltar mdog slod du zhang ston rin po che las bcu gcig zhal gyi sgrub thabs zhus te smyung gnas stong phrag gcig dam bca' mdzad nas sum brgya song ba'i sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga'i nyin phyag stong spyan stong zhal gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs nas grub pa brnyes/

sems can du ma smin grol la bkod/ gshegs ma thag tu byams pa'i drung nas bde ba can du phebs par grags pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i rnam thar brjod las 'das so// ༈ chos rgyal bde ba can pa ni/ 'khrungs yul mdog slod/ mtshan shākya byang chub/ rab tu byung nas thos bsam brtson zhing khyad par 'dul ba la mkhas/ sman bla dang sgrol ma la thugs dam mdzad pas 'phags mas lung bstan te rtsi 'dul drung du byon nas spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang khrid sgrub thabs zhus/ grangs bsnyen nyer gcig der mdzad nas slar phebs te mdog slod kyi gdan sa btab pas sku bsod skyes te lo re la phar 'dul gyi bshad grwa tshar nyi shu tsam re byung*/ smyung gnas stong phrag gcig gi dam bca' mdzad nas sum brgya song ba'i tshes brgyad kyi dngos gzhi'i nub mo dag snang du po ta lar phebs/ bkod pa'i khyad par mdo las gsungs ba ltar gzigs/ 'phags pas lung bstan byin gyis brlabs/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo du ma 'khrungs/ de phyin chad nas grub rtags mngon shes la thogs pa med cing sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad de ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas ri bo ta lar gshegs so// ༈ mkhan chen chu bzang pa ni/ mus ldang dkar du 'khrungs/ rab tu byung ba'i mtshan byang chub 'bar te mkhas pa'i sgo nas bstan pa'i bya ba mthar phyin/ 'phags pas lung bstan pa ltar mdog slod pa'i drung du sgrub thabs zhus/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin de nyid du smyung gnas mdzad pas sum brgya song ba'i tshes bco lnga'i dngos gzhi'i nub mo phyag stong spyan stong la bka' gdams brgyud pas bskor ba zhal gzigs/ sgrub yun ring yang da bar ma mjal ba'i yus gsol bas/ khyod dang skad cig kyang ma bral bar yod de dang po lung bstan pa'i dus su 'di bdud kyi sprul pa yin nam snyam du dogs pa zos pa des bsgribs pa yin gsungs nas byin gyis brlabs/ sems can don dpag med gyis shig pa'i lung brnyes te/

de nas bzung 'phags pa dang mi 'bral bar bzhugs shing bsod snyoms la brten pa'i dge 'dun sum brgya re'i 'tsho ba sbyar ba sogs bstan 'gro'i don mtha' yas mdzad/ sman bla'i cho ga'i tshe sman bla mched brgyad zhal gzigs/ gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams kyis lha'i bdud rtsi drangs/ gnas chog mdzad pa na gnas brtan rnams dngos su byon pa sogs ngo mtshar mtha' yas/ lan gcig chos gsungs pa'i tshe/ da ste lo sum brgya tsam na gnas 'dir dus rtags gsum 'ong*/ de'i tshe nga'i chos 'di sgrub sla ba yin pas nan tan gyis shig /las ngan sdig pa'i phyag shing yin no gsungs/ re zhig na/ da nga 'gro bas nga'i rgyag lhag ma gang yod kyis dge ba gzhan bya mi dgos/ smyung gnas tshogs pa'i mi rnams la 'byor na gdan gcig /ma 'byor na thor thug re drangs/ de'ang ma 'byor na me shing dum pa re'i gzhi gyis dang 'di kho na bsod nams che ba de la 'phags pas dngos su gsungs pa yin/ mi'i zer lo tsam ma yin/ khong gis rdzun mi gsungs zhes sogs gdams par mdzad nas sku gshegs te pur zhag bdun na 'ja' lus su yal rgyu la/ zhag gsum na byis pa lo bdun pa'i tshod tsam gyur pa bu chen zhig gis mthong ste rten skal ma thob dogs pas sku gdung bzhus pa ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur to// ༈ chos rje shes rab 'bum ni/ gtsang du ya mtshan pa'i ltas bcas sku 'khrungs/ rab tu byung nas slob gnyer sbyangs pas dka' bzhi mkhyen nas grwa skor mdzad/ sngags rgyud du ma mkhyen cing sbyor drug bsgoms pas rtags bcu rdzogs/ mngon shes lnga thob par grags/ 'jam dpal dmar po zhal gzigs/ rje btsun mas lung bstan pa ltar/ chu bzang pa las 'phags pa'i sgrub thabs zhus nas zla ba gsum smyung gnas mdzad pas bcu gcig zhal la 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyis bskor ba gzigs te/ de nas bzung 'phags pa dang 'bral med du gyur/ shes rab kyi rtsal shin tu che zhing bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don dpag med mdzad de gshegs pa'i tshe na yang ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma byung ngo*//

༈ rgyal sras rin po che thogs med zhabs ni/ gtsang brag skyar sa g.yo zhing me tog gi char bab pa sogs ngo mtshar dang bcas te sku bltams/ brda 'phrod tsam nyid nas bdag las gzhan gces kyi thugs bcos min du 'khrungs/ skabs shig phyugs lug skyong bzhin par sngon gyi las 'phro sad de chos bros la byon/ bslab sbyang cher mdzad/ rab tu byung ba'i tshe na'ang me tog gi char sogs ltas ya mtshan du ma byung*/ mtshan bzang po dpal du gsol/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod kyi gzhung mtha' dag thugs su chud cing rig pa'i grags pas khyab ste bo dong e'i gdan sa mdzad/ sa skya dpal ldan bla ma/ bu ol gnyis/ sangs rgyas dbon/ rin chen gling pa/ dpang lo chen po sogs bla ma bzhi bcu tsam bsten nas rgya chos bod du 'gyur pa gangs can du yod do cog gsan pa mthar phyin/ 'gran zla bral ba'i yongs 'dzin gnyis las mkhan chen bsod nams grags la theg chen blo sbyong zhus te bsgoms pas byang chub kyi sems rnam gnyis gzhung las ji skad bshad pa de thugs su 'khrungs nas/ mdze skrang byung tshad kyi shig nad/ nad gdon zug gzer la sogs snying rje ba'i sems can gzigs so cog gi sdug bsngal de nyid du dngos su bzhes shing sems can de dag 'di phyi gnyis ka'i sdug bsngal las grol bar mdzad/ thugs bskyed chen mo gsan pa'i tshe sa g.yos 'ja' 'od sogs ya mtshan dpag med byung*/ chos rje shes rab 'bum pa las sbyor drug gsan pas rtags bcu yon tan brgyad rdzogs te grub rtags thon kyang*/ bla mas 'phags pa bcu gcig zhal nyid skye ba du ma'i lha skal du dgongs nas klu sgrub/ tsan+d+ra go mī/ dpal mo sogs lugs srol du ma'i dbang khrid sgrub thabs gnang*/ gdan sa'i chos dpon kyang dpang lo chen por zhus nas dgung lo zhe gsum pa la dngul chu chos rdzong gi dben par gshegs te nye gnas ma gtogs su yang mi mjal ba'i sku mtshams lo nyi shu la smyung gnas dang blo sbyong gtso bor gyur pa'i nyams bzhes dang*/

nyin re phyag bskor brgya rtsa re sogs mdo sngags chos spyod bcad khrims kyang phal pa'i blos mi 'khyud pa mdzad pas zla ba drug nas zhal bcu gcig pa la/ don zhags lha lnga sogs spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba zhal gzigs shing byin gyis brlabs pas 'phags pa dang dbyer mi phyed pa'i stong nyid snying rje khyad par can 'khrungs te/ rje rang byung ba'i bu tre'o rtogs ldan gyis/ thugs rje chen po byas kyang gyang la bris pa'i dkar po de la zer ba min/ sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa lta bu'i 'du shes mnga' zhing stong nyid snying rje klong du gyur pa rgyal sras thogs med 'dra ba la zer ba yin zhes gsungs pas mtshon no// rtag tu rang skyon kho nar rtog cing gzhan skyon mi rtog pas mchog dman kun gyi yon tan gleng ba 'ba' zhig lhur mdzad/ chos brgyad gtan nas mi mnga'/ byams pa'i mthu yis drung dang nye ba'i mi phyugs thams cad rang bzhin gyi dul te/ ri dwags dang gcan gzan/ byi'u dang byi la/ khyi dang sprang po sogs kyang phan tshun gcig gis gcig la sdang ba'i sems brjed pa ltar 'bol shig gi 'gro/ bzhugs gdan na bza' tshun chad kyang gzhan la ster ba sogs phar phyin drug la chad med du spyod de/ mdor na/ brtse dang snyan par smra ba dang*// brtan pa nyid dang lag brkyang dang*// dgongs pa zab mo res 'grel ba// 'di dag blo ldan rnams kyi rtags// zhes pa mngon du gyur/ sems bskyed sogs chos gar gsung du me tog gi char chen po rtag tu bab/ zhal nas/ jo bo yab sras kyi dus su sems bskyed kyi chos 'di bka' dog pas dus phyis kyang 'di 'bog pa nyung bas byang chub sems rgyud la skyes pa mang po ma byung*/ da nas bka' yang du btang ba yin pas nyid cag 'bog nus pa kun gyis phog cig ces gsungs/ na bza' dang gzim khang du tshul khrims kyi dris khyab/

bshes gnyen dang bu slob du mas thugs rje chen po'i skur yang yang mjal/ rmi lam sgyu lus mngon shes rnams la dbang thob/ so thar dang byang sems kyi sdom pa phog la/ 'chad rtsom mdzad pa/ dben pa bsten pa/ grub thob kyi slob ma thon pa sogs re re la bltas kyang sku tshe ril por de kho na mdzad pa 'dra bar yod/ skabs de'i bod kyi che dgu dang*/ skad rigs mi gcig pa'i skye bo grangs las 'das pa mthong thos dran reg thams cad byang chub kyi sar smin pa dang grol bar mdzad nas bya lo zla ba dgu pa'i tshes nyi shu'i dgong mor cho 'phrul mtha' yas pa bstan te 'phags pa'i thugs kar thim mo// rje de la mkhas grub kyi slob ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon pa'i nang nas jo gdan dkon mchog bzang po nas snyag lu mkhan chen sogs brgyud de/ gar dbang lnga pa'i yig cha la chags med zhabs kyis gsal ka mdzad pa kaṃ tshang lugs srol da lta'ang rgyun bzhugs la sogs bod gangs can gyi grub mtha' kun la rgyal sras zhabs kyi slob tshogs las gyes pa'i rgyun kho na dar che zhing*/ rje rig pa 'dzin pa'i yig cha ni jo nang gi srol ka dang 'brel ba ste/ de ni brag dkar sems dpa' chen po bsod nams rin chen yab sras nas 'jam mgon grol mchog dang*/ kun snying sogs mkhas grub kyi skyes bu ches che ba dag las brgyud pa ste/ rnam thar ni smos kyis ma lang la/ da lta'i bar du byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa shes par bya'o// gsum pa las sgrub pa'i dus ni/ spyir gong gsal gyi zla zhag 'gyur khyad can rnams skabs su gang babs kyang rung la/ khyad par sa ga zla bar dpal mo nyid dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma phal cher kyang grub pa brnyes nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus khyad par can yin pas der smyung gnas byas na bar chad mi 'byung zhing dngos grub myur bar gsungs/ bsnyen pa'i tshad la dus bsnyen ni/ smyung gnas lan brgyad la sngon dngos rjes dang 'brel ba'i nyin zhag phyed dang bcu bdun te deng sang dkar po cha brgyad du grags pa 'di'o// grangs bsnyen ni gzungs ring khri phrag bzhi/

gzungs thung 'bum phrag gcig /snying po 'bum phrag drug /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i gzungs stong phrag gcig /sa bcu pa dang sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs ci rigs bzla bar gsungs so// rtags kyi bsnyen pa ni brgyud pa'i rnam thar du gsal ba ltar mtshan ma ma brnyes bar du ste grangs nges med do// bzhi pa de ltar bsgrubs pa'i phan yon la'ang*/ dang po 'phags pas dam bcas pa'i gnad kyis 'brel pa bzhag na mi bslu ba'i tshul ni phyag stong spyan stong thugs rje thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i gzungs las/ bcom ldan 'das sems can gang la la zhig thugs rje chen po'i rigs sngags 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa dang*/ gal te ngan 'gro gsum po dag tu ltung bar gyur na/ bdag nam yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bgyi'o// de bzhin du/ gal te sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rnams su skye bar ma gyur na bdag nam yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bgyi'o// gal te ting 'dzin dang spobs pa tshad ma mchis pa snyed thob par ma gyur na bdag nam yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bgyi'o// gal te tshe 'di nyid la smon pa thams cad ji ltar smon pa bzhin du grub par ma gyur na snying rje chen po'i sems kyi gzungs zhes mi bgyi lags te/ mi dge ba rnams dang*/ sems rtse gcig tu ma bgyis pa ni ma gtogs lags so// bud med gang la la zhig bud med kyi lus kyis yongs su skyo nas skyes pa'i lus thob par 'tshal ba gang lags pa des thugs rje chen po'i sems kyi gzungs kyi tshig 'di 'don cing yongs su bzung bas gal te bud med kyi dngos po las yongs su gyur te/ skyes pa'i lus thob par ma gyur na bdag nam yang mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mi bgyi'o// the tshom gyi bsam pa cung zad cig bskyed par gyur na gdon mi 'tshal bar gang smon pa'i 'bras bu de mngon par 'grub par mi 'gyur lags so// sems can gang la la zhig dge 'dun gyi zhal zas dang dkor 'phrog cing chud gson pa gang lags pa de dag ni sangs rgyas stong 'jig rten du byung ba dag la 'gyod pas mthol zhing bshags na'ang 'byang zhing tshangs par mi 'gyur mod kyi/

'on kyang thugs rje chen po'i rigs sngags 'di bton pa tsam gyis de dag yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur ba lags te/ dkon mchog gsum gyi zhal zas dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi dkor nor 'phrog cing chud gson pa de dag ni phyogs bcu'i ston pa rnams mngon sum du gyur pa'i spyan sngar bshags na gdod yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur lags la/ thugs rje chen po'i gzungs 'di 'don pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i ston pa rnams der gshegs nas dbang mdzad par 'gyur bas kha na ma tho ba'i sgrib pa de dag thams cad kyang yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur/ mi dge ba bcu dang*/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga dang*/ gang zag la skur ba btab pa dang*/ gso sbyong bshigs pa dang*/ tshul khrims bshigs pa dang*/ mchod rten bshigs pa dang*/ gtsug lag khang bshigs pa thams cad dang*/ dge 'dun gyi dkor brkus pa dang*/ yongs su dag pa'i tshangs par spyod pa sun par bgyis pa 'di lta bu la sogs pa sdig pa'i las lci ba thams cad yongs su 'byang bar 'gyur lags so// rigs sngags 'di la the tshom 'tshal ba'i dngos po gcig ni ma gtogs te/ the tshom 'tshal bar gyur nas/ kha na ma tho ba chung ngu'i las yang ba tsam yang yongs su 'byang bar mi 'gyur na kha na ma tho ba lci ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags/ kha na ma tho ba lci ba dag yongs su 'byang bar mi 'gyur mod kyi/ 'on kyang byang chub kyi ring ba'i rgyu ni bgyid par 'gyur lags so// zhes dang*/ gzhan las kyang 'di skad du/ 'khor ba'i btson dong nyam nga bar gnas pa'i sems can 'di rnams bdag gis drangs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bkod par bgyi'o// 'khor ba dong sprug gi phrin las bsgrub par bgyi'o// bdag gi gdong bcu gcig gis rtag tu lta zhing lag pa stong gis byabs par bgyi'o// rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang dag tshes brgyad dam bco lnga'i dus bab pa'i tshe/ smyung bar gnas pa'am/ bsnyen gnas la gnas pa dag gis kyang rung ste/

bdag gi ming nas brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du brjod cing phyag 'tshal bar byed/ yid la sems par byed na/ sems can des mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas kyang*/ de nges par drangs nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar bgyi'o// yid la sems par byed na/ sems can des mtshams med pa lnga'i las byas kyang nges par drangs nas bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye bar bgyi ste/ ngan song dang ngan 'gror 'gro ba'i gnas ma mchis go skabs ma mchis so// gal te sems can de ngan 'gror song na/ bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes dam bcas te/ 'phags pa rnams ni bden tshig grub pas nam mkha' gzhan du gyur kyang dam bcas pa mi bslu ba dang*/ nges par smon lam 'grub pa dbang bcu brnyes pa'i yon tan no// gnyis pa sangs rgyas gzhan las kyang spyan ras gzigs thugs rje che ste/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs las/ gang la la zhig gis sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma'i mtshan nas brjod cing yid la bsam pa dang*/ gzhan yang 'ga' zhig gis skad cig gcig tsam du bsam pa thag pa nas/ bdag gi ming nas brjod cing rjes su dran par gyur na de gnyis kyi yon tan mnyam zhing mtshungs lags so// bdag gi ming nas brjod la de dag thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog pa'i sa 'thob par 'gyur/ bro nad thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur/ sgrib pa thams cad dang 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur/ lus dang ngag yid kyi nongs pa zhu/ byang bar 'gyur na bdag gis bstan pa'i rigs sngags 'di/ len pa dang*/ 'dzin pa dang*/ klog pa dang*/ 'don pa dang*/ ci skad bstan pa bzhin du sgrub pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal lags te/ gang zag de dag ni bla na ma mchis pa'i byang chub lag mthil du mchis pa bzhin du khong du chud cing legs par 'gyur bar rig par bgyi lags so// zhes gsungs shing khyad par snyigs ma'i 'gro ba spyi dang gangs can gyi gdul bya la byin rlabs lhag par myur ba yongs su grags pa ltar/

sngon thugs bskyed pa'i tshe na'ang*/ khyad par du snyigs ma'i dus lnga brgya tha ma pa'i sems can nyon mongs pa rags shing mi dge ba bcu la spyod pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga dang*/ 'phags pa la skur pa 'debs pa dang*/ chos la skur ba 'debs pa dang*/ mchod rten dang gtsug lag khang bshigs pa dang*/ tshul khrims 'chal zhing nyams pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi nor brkus pa dang*/ tshangs par spyod pa'i dge 'dun la gnod pa byed pa dang*/ nya pa dang*/ phag pa dang*/ shan pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa chen po la spyod pa de dag bdag gi ming brjod pa dang gzungs sngags 'dren pa de dag gi 'dren pa mchog tu gyur cig /skyabs dang skyob pa dam par gyur cig /gling dang dpung gnyen dam par gyur cig /ces sogs dam bcas shing*/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rigs las kyang bcu gcig zhal nyid rtsa ba'i lha yin pa dang*/ ma 'ongs snyigs dus kyi gdul bya 'dul bar dam bcas pas byin rlabs che ba byang sems pas gsungs te/ de'ang cho ga zhib mo las/ 'di ltar bdag ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ sems can la phan pa dang*/ bde ba dang*/ zhi bar bgyid nus par 'gyur zhe na/ da nges par bdag gi lus la lag pa stong dang*/ mig stong yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig /ces smon lam btab pa'i mod la phyag stong spyan stong du gyur te/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur zhing ltas chen po bco brgyad byung bar gsungs la/ rgyud pad drwar/ phyis ni 'dren pa shākya zhes// mi mjed 'jig rten khams 'khrungs tshe// mi yul las kyang khyad par du// yi ze ta ste bor/ mchan/ dwags gling du skyes pa 'ga'// bstan la 'dud 'phel bya ba'i phyir// mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum du// skad cig glog 'gyu ci lta bar// rig sngags 'chang ba gdong bcu gcig /yan lag stong dang ldan pa la// spyan ni chig stong sum cu pa'i// mtshan dang ldan pa'i sku 'byung 'gyur// de tshe skal ldan la la zhig

/mtshan nas brjod cing sku la mos// rig sngags zlos pa po gang zhig /'jig rten 'dod pa kun 'grub cing*// phyi nas ye shes nyis 'gyur ro// zhes 'das pa'i bskal par sangs rgyas tshe dpag med ces pas mgon po nyid la lung bstan par gsungs pa'i dgongs par snang ngo*// gzhan yang de nyid las/ gaṅgā'i klung brgya'i sangs rgyas kyi// mtshan nas brjod cing bstod pa bas// rigs kyi bu'am bu mo gang*// bdag gi ming brjod dran byed cing*// rig sngags rgyun tu brjod na de// myur du mchog dga'i sa thob cing*// lag pa'i mthil nas mthong ba ltar// bla med byang chub myur du 'byung*// zhes dang*/ dam chos pad dkar du/ gang zhig sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi bye ma snyed 'tsho zhing gzhes pa la yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bsnyen bkur byed cing mtshan nas brjod de phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ gang zhig spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan lan gcig brjod de phyag lan gcig byas pa'i bsod nams dag mnyam par gsungs shing*/ za ma tog bkod par/ rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dper na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma phrag bcu gnyis dang mnyam pa la/ na bza' dang*/ bshos dang*/ mal stan dang*/ na ba'i rkyen gyi sman gyi yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa'i bsod nams kyi phung po ni/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i skra'i nyag ma gcig la gnas pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam mo// zhes gsungs pas mchod bstod bsnyen sgrub bgyis pa'i phan yon kyang gzhan las ches che bar grub bo// gsum pa mdo sngags gnyis las kyang sngags kyi dkyil 'khor 'di lta bur zhugs nas sgrub pa nyid dngos grub ches myur bas khyad par 'phags tshul lung du ma dang/ rgyud pad+ma drwa ba las kyang*/ sngags dang rdzas dang phyag rgya'i rim// sna tshogs kyis ni don mdzad phyir// theg pa kun las khyad par du// sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags// nan tan sgrub pa smos ci dgos// sngags dang phyag rgya 'chang bas kyang*// nad dang gdon sel bskal pa yi// sgrib rnams 'byang bas khyad par 'phags// dbul po rigs dang dman pa yang*// zhugs ma thag nas bde ldan zhing*// cung zad grub nas nus mthu ni// dpag med 'byung bas khyad par 'phags// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa gzungs ring thung bzlas pa'i phan yon ni/

rgyud pad+ma drwa ba las/ rig sngags snying po gdong bcu gcig /mthu chen thogs pa med pa ste// 'gro la sman cing bde ba dang*// nad kun sel byed sdig kun sbyong*// rmi lam mtshan ma ngan kun sel// dus min 'chi dang ngan sems zlog /rtsod 'khrugs bdud dang gdon bgegs zhi// 'jig rten smon pa kun 'grub cing*// bdud dang bar chad mtshon cha'i nad// btson rar bcug dang mtshon chas bstsal// chu dang me dang rlung sa g.yo// dug dang byad stems ro langs dang*// chom rkun mi ma yin rnams gnon// rig sngags 'di yis bsrung ba dang*// len 'dri kha ton bshad sogs rnams// brtson la lhar bcas gnod pa med// sngon gyi las drag yod pa yang*// byang zhing bsrabs te med par 'gyur// zhes sogs dang*/ gang gis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal mchod// skyabs su 'gro zhing sdig pa bshags// mngon par dga' zhing gsang sngags 'di// nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pa la// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ma lus pa// mtshungs par yi rangs legs so sbyin// rtsa ba bzhi dang mtshams med lnga// ma lus sdig kun byang bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ yang*/ rtag tu nang par sngar langs nas// chos bzhin du ni dge bgyis te// brgya rtsa brgyad du gang brjod pa// tshe 'dir phan yon bcu thob 'gyur// rtag par lus la nad med dang*// lha dang sangs rgyas kun gyis srung*// nor 'bru rin chen gos rnyed dang*// dgra sdang dul zhing 'jigs med dang*// bza' rnams bkur zhing rigs btsun thob// dug dang 'dre gshin gdon bral dang*// lus la dri zhim kun dga' dang*// bsam ngan mi snyan rjod byed dang*// rims nad bral zhig dgang sla dang*// dus min 'chi ba sangs par 'gyur// gzhan yang yon tan bzhi thob ste// 'chi khar sangs rgyas zhal mthong dang*// mkha' la 'od 'byung lhas mchod dang*// nam yang ngan 'gror mi 'gro zhing*// bde ba can nam bde 'gror skye// 'di 'dzin sangs rgyas byang sems kyi// rnam par thar pa'i chos sgo 'thob// ces sogs gsungs la/

zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs las/ bcom ldan 'das snying po gdong bcu gcig pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bcu gcig gis gsungs pa lags te/ de sems can thams cad la sman pa dang*/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa dang*/ sdig pa dang bkra mi shis pa dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad zlog par bgyid pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad zlog par bgyid pa dang*/ ma zhugs pa rnams dad pa dang*/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad zhi bar bgyi ba'i slad du bshad par bgyi'o// bcom ldan 'das snying po 'dis bsrung zhing zhi bar bgyis pa la 'gal bar bgyid pa de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na gnas ma mchis te/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni ma gtogs so// zhes dang*/ nangs par langs nas brgya rtsa brgyad bton na tshe 'di la yon tan bcu yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe na/ bro nad ma mchis par 'gyur ba dang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yongs su bzung ba dang*/ nor dang 'bru rnams 'bad med du rnyed pa dang*/ dgra thams cad thul ba dang*/ rgyal po rnams byams pa dang*/ dug dang*/ dbyig dug dang*/ rims kyis mi tshugs pa dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi bas dus byed par mi 'gyur lags so// gzhan yang yon tan bzhi yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur te/ 'chi ba'i dus de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'gyur ba dang*/ ngan song rnams su mi skye ba dang*/ ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus mi byed pa dang*/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur lags so// zhes sogs dang*/ lan gcig brjod pas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi po dag kyang byang bar 'gyur/ mtshams ma mchis pa lnga po dag kyang ma lus pa 'byang bar 'gyur na/ ji skad du bshad pa bzhin tu nan tan bgyid pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ de dag ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag du ma la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur ba lags na/

bzlas brjod bgyid pa dang*/ sgrub pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal te bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin tu rdzogs par bgyi'o// zhes sogs gsungs la/ rig sngags snying po las/ gang la la zhig gis zla ba phyed kyi tshes bcu bzhi'am bco lnga la smyung ba bgyis te/ sdom pa yang dag par blangs nas chos bzhin tu yongs su dag par bgyis te/ sems rtse gcig tu bdag rjes su dran par bgyis nas rig sngags 'di bzlas brjod bgyis na bskal pa bzhi khri'i 'khor ba bsnyil bar 'gyur lags so// zhes gsungs shing*/ yang pad drwa'i rgyud las/ rig sngags 'di gsungs pa'i rjes su// rtsa ba'i snying po stong brjod pas// dngos grub ci dang ci 'dod 'grub// ces dang*/ rtsa ba'i rig pa de'i rjes thog tu gsungs nas cho ga'i tshul yang zhib par bstan cing 'di skad du// mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang gi /sngags gang brjod pa tsam la yang*// gshis ngan shi ba bco lnga med// skye bzang bco lnga thob par 'gyur// mu ge rgyal po'i chad pa dang*// dug dang mtshon dang g.yul 'gyed dang*// stag sogs sbrul sogs gcan gzan gdug /dug can zas dang me chus 'chi// srog chags mdun tu nyal nyes dang*// g.yeng byed dang ni lha 'dres gtses// gsor mi rung dang bdag lceb rnams// de la nam yang mi 'jigs so// rgyal po chos ldan yul skye zhing*// 'phags pa bzhugs dang dus bzang yul// bshes gnyen bzang dang dbang po tshang*// dge la dga' zhing tshul khrims ldan// bran khol bzang zhing nor mang rtag /gzhan gyis bkur zhing dgos 'dod sbyor// sems bder 'jig rten skyong bas srung*// sangs rgyas zhal mthong don zab brtags// gzhan yang dman la byams sems bskyed// snying rje mchi ma 'khrugs pa dang// yon tan dran nas spro ba dang*// dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang*// phul du byung ba'i blo gros 'phel// tshul bzhin ma yin yid bral dang*// bka' lung sde snod dad pa rnams// yang nas yang du skye bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/

rgyud pad+ma cod pan las/ sngags 'di 'don pa bgyid pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mos lan cig brjod dam dran zhing yid la byas sam lus la bcangs na mtshams med pa lnga dang*/ de dang nye ba'i sdig pa'i las byang zhing sems can dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i skye gnas su mi skye zhing mi khom pa brgyad du sdug bsngal dang bcas par mi 'gyur ro// gcan gzan dang*/ srin po dang*/ mi ma yin pa dang*/ nad dang 'jigs pa thams cad las grol bar 'gyur ro// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs la/ spyir phyag stong spyan stong ngam/ nam mkha' rgyal po la rnam 'gyur dang snying po mi 'dra ba mang du mchis kyang*/ dpal mo lugs kyi bzla bya'i gtso bo gdong bcu gcig pa'i gzungs ring thung yin la/ gzhan tu mgrin sngon can gyi gzungs nyid rtsa ba'i rig sngags chen mor gsungs ba ltar klu sgrub kyi sgrub thabs kyang de la bsten cing*/ de'i phan yon mtha' yas pa zhig las 'phags zhabs kyis bsdus pa ni/ gzungs 'di lan cig brjod pas rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi byung ba yang ma lus par 'byang bar 'gyur ro// 'di 'dzin pa de la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyis rgyun mi 'chad par spyan stong gi thugs rjes gzigs shing*/ phyag stong gis bskyab par 'gyur ro// mtshams med pa lnga dang de dang nye ba lnga dang dge 'dun gyi dkor rku 'phrog byas pa rnams kyang lan gcig brjod pas ma lus par zad par 'gyur ro// the tshom za ba ni ma gtogs so// gshis ngan tu 'chi ba bco lnga mi 'byung zhing*/ skye ba bzang po bco lnga 'dzin par 'gyur ro// sus snying po 'di'i ming thos pa de ni bskal pa du ma'i skye 'chi'i las bsags pa lci ba rnams kyang byang bar 'gyur na brjod cing 'dzin pa lta ci smos/ rgyun mi 'chad par bzung na sa bcu'i 'bras bu thob pa la dka' ba med na 'jig rten pa'i bsod nams lta ci smos/

zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas phan yon bskyed pa'i phyir gzungs 'di'ang lan grangs kha shas bzla zhing*/ de yang*/ bdag gi slob dpon 'od dpag med rtag tu dran par bgyi'o// de nas gsang sngags 'di brjod par rigs so// zhes gsungs pa ltar bya'o// lnga pa yig drug bzlas pa'i phan yon ni// spyir rgyud sde bzhi ka nas gsungs so cog gi thugs rje chen po'i rigs thams cad kyi yang snying yig drug nyid yin pas so sor bshad pa'i phan yon thams cad kyang de kho na la tshang bar 'gyur te/ pad+ma cod pan las/ de rnams kyi sngags bsdus pa ni/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ zhes pa'o// 'dis ni rigs gsum gyi bdag por 'gyur te phan yon ni de'o// chos kyi sku dang gzugs kyi sku'i thugs rje chen po mthong bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*// khyad par za ma tog bkod par/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang po'i snying po dam pa'o// gang yang yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'dzin cing zlos pa'i sems can de dag ni bsod nams dang ldan pa ste/ de dag zlos pa'i tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dgu bcu rtsa dgu 'du bar 'gyur ro// byang chub sems dpa' rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa 'du bar 'gyur ro// pha rol tu phyin pa drug sgo na gnas par 'gyur ro// gzhan yang lha'i sde sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha'i bu dag 'du/ rgyal po chen po bzhis ni phyogs bzhi nas bsrung*/ klu'i rgyal po dang klu bye ba stong phrag du mas ni yongs su srung*/ sa bla'i gnod sbyin dag ni bla gab med par srung par byed do// de'i ba spu'i khung bu re re la yang de bzhin gshegs pa bye ba bzhugs te/ khyod kyis rigs rus bdun brgyud tshun chad du yid bzhin gyi nor bu thob par byas/ lus kyi srog chags thams cad kyang phyir mi ldog par bkod par byas te legs so legs so zhes sbyin par mdzad do// la la zhig gis lus la 'chang na de ni rdo rje'i lus/

ring bsrel gyi mchod rten/ rgyal ba'i ye shes su rig par bya'o// gang zhig 'di zlos pa de ni spobs pa mi zad cing ye shes kyi phung po rnam par dag la snying rje chen po dang ldan te nyi ma re re zhing phar phyin drug yongs su rdzogs nas rig 'dzin gyis 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub kyang myur du thob par 'gyur ro// de'i lag gis reg pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa' srid pa tha ma par 'gyur ro// sems can gang dag tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gyur pas kyang mthong ngam/ de'i yid kyis sems par byed na de dag skye rga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal 'dzad de srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpar 'gyur ro// zhes sogs dang*/ yang*/ rdul phra rab kyi rdul/ rgya mtsho'i mching gi bye ma/ gling bzhi pa'i chu'i thigs pa dang 'bru dang spu'i tshogs dang thang shing gi lo ma ji snyed yod pa/ lo bcu gnyis su nyin mtshan med par char bab pa'i thigs pa re re nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyis bgrang nus la/ yi ge drug pa lan gcig bzlas pa'i bsod nams ni bgrang mi nus pa dang*/ gling bzhi pa'i sems can thams cad sa bdun pa la gnas par gyur pa de'i bsod nams las kyang yig drug lan gcig bzlas pas che ba sogs gsungs la/ gzhan yang yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'drir 'jug pa des ni chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong 'drir 'jug par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas kyi sku rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa lha'i gser rin po che las nyin re bzhin du byed cing ring bsrel 'jug pa de'i rnam par smin pa ni yi ge drug pa'i 'bru gcig gi rnam par smin pa ste yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab bo// 'di zlos par byed na ting nge 'dzin brgya rtsa brgyad thob par 'gyur ro// rnal 'byor gzhan rnams ni phub ma dang mtshungs la 'di ni 'bras kyi snying por gyur pa'o// zhes sogs mdo rgyud du ma nas rgya cher bsngags pa'i don bsdus rgyal po bka' chems su'ang gsal zhing*/

sprul pa'i rgyal po'i zhal gdams kyi sgrub skor rnams su'ang yig drug kho na gtso bor mdzad la/ mdor na ngag tu bzla bya'i sngags zhig la yig drug 'dra ba'i phan yon che ba gzhan na med pas 'di kho nar rtag tu brtson par rigs so// drug pa bla ma rnams kyis man ngag gi tshul du kha bskang ba'i gzungs las/ yid bzhin 'khor lo la'ang lha sngags kyi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba 'byung yang*/ phan yon yid bzhin nor bu 'khor los sgyur ba'i gzungs su thams cad tshang bas/ de ni de nyid las/ rigs kyi bu'am bu mo/ 'khor bzhi po gang su yang rung bas 'bras bu mod la thob par 'tshal bas/ yid bzhin nor bu'i phyag rgya la mngon par brtson par bgyi'o// tshes grangs rgyu skar sbyar mi 'tshal// smyung ba'i cho ga bgyi mi 'tshal// khrus dang gos gsar bgo mi 'tshal// de bzhin sgrub pa'i cho ga med// bklag pa nyid kyis 'grub 'gyur te// bzlas brjod tsam gyis the tshom med// las ni stong dang brgya yang bgyid// 'di dang mtshungs pa'i rigs sngags med// sngon gyi sdig sgrib zad 'gyur te// btab pa tsam gyis mnar med par// 'chi ba'i sdig pa 'phral du dag /ces dang*/ mtshams med pa'i sdig pa ma lus pa zad par 'gyur/ nad thams cad dang*/ rims dang*/ byad stems dang*/ gnod sbyin dang srin po la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad las thar zhing phyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ dug dang*/ mtshon dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ lce 'bab pas mi tshugs/ chom rkun dang*/ rgyal po dang*/ dgra dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa mi 'byung*/ rmi lam ngan pa mi rmi/ 'thab pa dang rtsod pa thams cad las rgyal bar 'gyur/ lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas de'i nyin mor 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs mngon sum du ston te dbugs 'byin cing dngos grub stsol bar bgyid/ 'od dpag med sogs de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can dang*/

ri bo ta la'i gzhal med khang rnams kyang mthong bar 'gyur ro// 'chi ba'i tshe 'phags pa mngon sum du mthong zhing sangs rgyas kyi zhing du pad ma las brdzus te skye bar 'gyur/ tshe rabs thams cad du skye ba dran pa dang*/ rtag tu ngan song du mi ltung ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang yang thob par 'gyur ro// zhes sogs gsungs so// sa bcu pa'i gzungs rigs bcu po 'bum phrag re bzlas pas sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar thob pa sogs phan yon rgya chen smos kyis mi lang pas de'i khungs don zhags kyi rtog pa chen mor gsal zhing*/ pad+mo uṣ+ṇi ṣa'i phan yon mdor bsdus ni/ gang gis gsang sngags yi ge bcu pa 'bum bzlas brjod bgyis na sa bcu la gnas zhing phyir mi ldog par don yod pa'i pad+ma gtsug tor gyi 'khor lor bsgyur par 'gyur te the tshom mi bya'o// yig 'bru re re tsam bzlas pas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa byed par 'gyur na ches ngal zhing dub par sgrub na lta smos kyang ci dgos/ nyin zhag gcig smyung bar gnas pa'am/ gang la la skad cig yud tsam du snying po 'di lan cig dran na/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa/ mnar med du tshe bskal par gzhol pa yang rnam par dag cing*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad zad/ nam yang ngan 'gror mi 'gro zhing tshe rabs dran par 'gyur/ bskal pa 'bum phrag du ma re re bzhin du/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid dang*/ mngon par dga' ba dang*/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten la sogs par skyes nas bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ nyin re bzhin du sems can thams cad la dmigs nas lan bdun bdun brjod na de bzhin gshegs pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed par 'gyur/ tshe brjes nas bde ba can tu skye zhing ting nge 'dzin brgya phrag du ma dag kyang thob par 'gyur/ bye ma gtsang ma la sngags nas ro'am rus pa'am dur khrod dang pur khang sogs su gtor na bslab sdom ral ba la sogs pas ngan song du skyes pa rnams kyang de ma thag tu tshe brjes nas mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur/

gro ga la bris nas mchod rten gyi nang du bcug na de'i grib mas phog pa'i srog chags thams cad mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur/ dung la sngags te ri mthon por bus pa'i sgra sdom pa la zhugs pas thos na phyir mi ldog par bde ba can tu skye bar 'gyur/ sems can tha mal pa sus thos mtho ris su gzhol bar 'gyur/ tsan+dan la sngags te dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba sogs mang po 'tshogs pa'i dbus su bdug na dri mnams pa thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sku yongs su rdzogs shing*/ chos gos la bdug nas gyon na gang zag de'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa zad/ srang khar bdug na 'thab rtsod dang yams nad chad/ 'brog tu bdug na dgra rkun gcan gzan bcings/ rims nad sogs la bdug na nad zhi ba la sogs pa rgya cher gsungs so// sgo mtha' yas pa'i gzungs ni/ de nyid las/ sangs rgyas kun gyis de ni yid la mdzad// de la bdud kyis glags ni rnyed mi 'gyur// de yi las kyi sgrib pa myur du 'byang*// spobs pa mtha' yas rnams kyang thob par 'gyur// zhes sogs phan yon du ma gsungs la/ 'di ni zhal blta zhing gsung thos pa la sgrib pa'i tshogs myur du sbyong ba'i dgos pa khyad par can dang 'brel ba zhig go// de ltar bsnyen pa rnams grangs them zhing spyan ras gzigs kyi rnal 'byor la brtson pa de mthong thos dran reg 'brel tshad don ldan du gsungs te/ mdo btus las/ gal te thugs rje chen po'i gzungs 'di 'don cing yongs su 'dzin pa de dag chu klung ngam rgya mtshor zhugs te khrus byas pa'i chus lus la reg pa'i der gnas sems can thams cad sdig pa'i las dang*/ kha na ma tho ba lci ba yongs su byang nas zhing dag par pad+ma las rdzus te skye bar 'gyur na kha ton tu byed pa dang 'chang ba rnams lta ci smos/ lam du zhugs nas 'gro ba'i tshe rlung langs te gang zag de'i lus dang gos la reg pa'i rlung de phyogs gzhan tu song nas sems can gang gi lus la reg kyang*/
