de dag gi sdig sgrib lci ba ma lus pa byang nas ngan song gsum gyi rnam smin mi myong zhing rtag par sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar skye bar 'gyur na 'don pa dang*/ yongs su 'dzin pa de dag gis thos pa'i phan yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab par rig par bya'o// zhes dang*/ byang sems pas/ gzungs sngags 'di rnams dud 'gro pho mo 'chi ba'i rna lam du bsgrag na lha mi'i lus thob cing byang chub sems kyi sa bon thebs te bde ba can du skye bar gsungs so// bdun pa cho ga byas pa'i phan yon ni/ rgyud pad drwar/ bcu bzhi'am ni bco lnga dang*// khyad par du ni tshes brgyad la// gso sbyong sku yi mdun tu blang*// skyon med tsan+dan dkar sogs shing*// rigs bzang las byas sku gzugs sam// yang na sa rdo rin chen sogs// bzang las bde bar gshegs gzugs bya// yang na ris su bris kyang rung*// sku gcig po'am lha tshogs kyi// dkyil 'khor rgyas par byas pa la// mngon sum bzhin tu dmigs byas na// myur du mngon sum mthong bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ yon tan kun gyis brgyan pa yi// bum pa chu dang bcas pa la// sngags brjod pa ni 'dod don kun// 'grub 'gyur the tshom mi bya'o// zhes bum chog dang zhar byung phan yon bcas bstan pa dang*/ cho ga zhib mo las/ su zhig gzungs sngags 'di 'dzin pa des/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba nya ba la bslab pa'i gzhi brgyad bzung ste/ gos gtsang ma bgos la ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten gyi mdun du'am/ sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyi spyan sngar tsan dan dkar po'i dkyil 'khor bgyis la/ der me tog sna tshogs gtor bar bgyi/ bdug pas kyang bdug par bgyi/ mar me yang bud par bgyi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la gus pa bskyed par bgyi'o// gzungs sngags 'di'ang lan brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas brjod bgyis na/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dkyil 'khor der 'dug ste/

mtshams med pa la sogs pa las kyi sgrib pa ji snyed yod pa thams cad 'byang bar 'gyur ro// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las rnams kyang yongs su dag par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin dang 'od zer gyis dbang bskur ba'i stobs kyang 'thob bo// sa dang pha rol du phyin pa yang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'ang rgyud rigs mthun pa'i dbang gis cho ga 'di'i yang lung khungs su 'gyur la/ de bzhin du/ thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i gzungs las/ gang la la zhig rtag par spos sam me tog snyim pa gang tsam sku gzugs kyi mdun du gtor nas gzungs 'don par bgyid na/ stong chen po'i 'jig rten khams kyi yon tan dang snying rje chen po'i chos nyid 'thob par 'gyur/ mthar gyis mthu chen po mngon par 'grub par 'gyur lags so// zhes dang*/ rgyud pad drwar/ nad dang 'phrod pa'i sman rnams la// sngags bzlas bza' 'am byugs pa'am// bdug pa tsam yang gnod pa sel// srad bu'am ni gos dag dang*// phyag rgyas gdags kyang de bzhin no// zhes pa'i las tshogs dang*/ zhal bcu gcig pa'i gzungs las/ chab la lan brgya rtsa brgyad sngags te lus la gtor na sgrib pa dang bgegs thams cad ngang gis byang nas smon pa thams cad yid bzhin tu 'grub par 'gyur lags so// zhes gzungs khrus kyi phan yon dang*/ byang sems zla rgyal gyi zhal nas phan yon mtha' yas pa zhig gsungs pa'i gsham du/ skyes pa rnams kyis 'di'i smyung gnas lan gcig byas pas bde ba can du skye/ bud med rnams kyis smyung gnas lan gcig byas pas 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs te dang po'i yon tan thob/ smyung gnas sngon 'gro gdan gcig gi nyin mi gcig la 'tsho ba drangs nas brgyad pa'i byang sems la 'tsho ba drangs pa dang bsod nams mnyam zhing*/ smyung gnas tshar ba'i phyir nang mi gcig la 'tsho ba drangs kyang rang sangs rgyas lnga brgya la drangs pa dang 'dra/

gso sbyong blangs pa tsam la drangs na dgra bcom pa la drangs pa'i phan yon thob pa dang*/ sbyin bdag de ngan song gsum dang*/ nad mtshon mu ge'i bskal par nam yang mi skye zhing*/ tshe rabs thams cad du bde skyid phun sum tshogs/ byang chub kyi sems rgyud la 'khrungs pa sogs phan yon mang du 'byung bar gsungs so// de dag la'ang the tshom med pa kho na gal che ste/ the tshom cung zad cig yod na 'bras bu ci'ang mi 'grub pa sngags rgyud spyi dang gong du drangs pa'i lung las gsal lo// brgyad pa bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa'i phan yon ni/ spyir sbyin pa las tshul khrims sogs phar phyin drug phyi rim bzhin tu phan yon che bas/ shes rab ste stong pa nyid sgom pa'i phan yon ni/ ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad dge ba bcu'i lam du bkod pa bas/ gang gis chos bdag med pa la mos te dben pa'i phyogs su gom pa bdun bor ba bsod nams che'o// zhes dang*/ de kho na nyid bstan pa'i mdo las/ shā ri'i bu/ gang gis bskal pa gcig gi bar du nyan pa bas/ se gol gtogs pa'i yun tsam de kho na nyid la mnyam par bzhag na bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo// zhes dang*/ rtog pa chen po las/ thang gcig bsam gtan thun zhugs na// khams gsum gang ba'i mi rnams la// srog byin pas ni de don che// zhes sogs brjod las 'das par gsungs shing*/ de thams cad las kyang sngags rgyud dang 'brel pa'i dge rtsa cung zad re phan yon che ste/ dus 'khor rtsa rgyud las/ gdol pa smyig ma mkhan sogs dang*// mtshams med lnga ni byed pa yang*// sngags kyi spyod pa rjes spyad na// tshe 'di nyid la 'tshang rgya 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa zhig yin kyang chags bral gyi lha sku brgya rtsa las sngags su gsungs pa'i lha sku gcig bzhengs pa bsod nams che bar gsungs pa des 'gre zhing*/

zhu bde'i khyad par can gyi bskyed rdzogs sgom pa'i yon tan ni mang du smos ci 'tshal/ nges par las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa myur du zad cing*/ mchog thun mong gnyis ka tshe 'di'am bar do las mi 'gyangs par thob/ gnas skabs su'ang lus la bde ba/ ngag la nus pa/ sems la rtogs pa'i ye shes 'char/ 'chi ba'i tshe 'ja' 'od ring bsrel sa g.yos 'byung*/ khyad par du zhal bcu gcig pa nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo yin phyir de bsgom pas dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma lus pa bsgom par 'gyur/ zhal gyi kha dog bzhis 'phrin las bzhi 'grub pa dang*/ phyag re re la dmigs pa'i phan yon mi 'dra ba re re sogs mtha' yas pa gsungs so// de dag ni rgyud gzungs dag gi dkyus su bstan pa'i smyung gnas dang gzungs sngags cho ga'i phan yon mdor bsdus te/ bla ma gong ma'i man ngag gi phyag bzhes sgrub mchod lugs la ni/ de'i steng du phan yon lhag po du ma 'byung ste/ yan lag bdun po re re'i phan yon kyang brjod kyis mi lang pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa rjes ni/ spyir gsang sngags kyi srog dam tshig yin pas de ma bsrung na sngags kyi 'bras bu mi 'grub kyi steng du nyes dgu sna tshogs 'di phyi gnyis kar 'byung la/ bsrung na de las ldog pa'i dngos grub mchog thob ste/ de'ang*/ gsum la skyabs su song ba/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ rang rigs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur nod pa gzhir bzhag nas/ 'dir bya rgyud rang lugs kyi dam tshig gsang ba spyi rgyud kyi rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ legs grub nas gsungs pa'i rigs dang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyi lnga po sogs bsrung dgos kyang brir ma lang pas gzhan du shes par bya zhing*/ khyad par spyan ras gzigs kyi dam tshig tu/ byang sems rin po che'i zhal gdams kyi snying po ni/ rang la nyes pa med bzhin tu pha rol pos khro ba dang*/ gshe ba dang*/ rdeg pa dang*/

mtshang 'bru ba la slar lan mi ldon pa'i dge sbyong gi chos bzhi dang ldan pas/ lus kyis rdeg btsog 'phrog bcom/ ngag gis tshig rtsub skur 'debs/ yid kyis phrag dog gnod sems gang byung yang 'phags pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang rang gi sgrib sbyong du shes par bya/ mdor na skyid sdug ci byung yang 'phags pa nyid la blo lings kyis bskyur/ rang dang sems can kun gyi lus thugs rje chen po/ ngag yi ge drug ma/ yid rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug bsgom la/ gnod lan phan gdags gzhan phan 'ba' zhig gi bsam sbyor la nan tan ma byas na sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang 'gal zhing 'phags pa'i thugs kyis khrel nas byin rlabs rgyang ring du 'gro bas de rnams dang ma 'gal ba dang*/ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bdag gis len/ bdag gi bde dge gzhan la sbyin pa la bslab/ sems can thams cad bdag kho nas sangs rgyas kyis sa la 'god pa'i ched du dge ba'i las bgyid do snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral ba'i ngang*/ nyin re la 'phags pa'i bskyed rim thun re/ gzungs sngags rab brgya rtsa/ 'bring nyer gcig tha ma'ang bco lnga re ma chag par 'dren zhing*/ spyod lam rnam bzhi rang nyid gang la goms pa'i rnal 'byor dang bsre bas dge sbyor chu bo'i rgyun lta bus tshogs gnyis yar ldan tu spel bar bya'o// rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa gal che'i 'phros don ni/ de'ang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis yongs su ma bzung ba'i bdag cag snyigs ma'i 'gro ba mgon med rnams bskyab pa'i slad du/ ston pa shākya'i rgyal po thugs rje can 'dis bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig du mar chos tshig bzhi pa re'i don du lus srog longs spyod ltos med du dor ba sogs dka' ba grangs med pa spyad nas kyang byang chub brnyes te legs par gsungs pa'i dam chos rin po che 'di snyed cig las/

tha na tshig bzhi pa gcig gi don tsam lag len tu ma thebs na rang cag rjes 'jug rnams kyis/ ston pa bka' drin can de mi mnyes par byas pa yin pas/ des na thog mar chos 'chad nyan gal che la de'i phan yon kyang*/ byams pa seng ge'i mdo las/ gaṅgā'i bye snyed 'jig rten gser dag gis// bkang ste gang la sbyin pa byin pa bas// dus ngan tshe na tshig bcad gcig 'chad pa// de'i phan yon ci 'dra snga mar med// ces dang*/ rgyan stug las/ 'jam dpal phyogs gang na chos smra ba 'dug gam/ de mthong na mtshams med pa lnga byang bar 'gyur ro// de la mchod pa yang bya ste/ gal te chos smra ba des mtshams med pa lnga spyod kyang sems 'khrugs par mi bya'o// zhes dang*/ chos thos pas ngan 'gro'i sgo bcad cing myang 'das kyi sa bon bzhag ste/ de phyin chad chos rtogs pa'i blo gros can kho nar skye ba sogs mang du gsungs/ gzhan yang zung gi mdo las/ gang dag nga yi bstan pa la// sbyin pa skra tsam byin pa ni/ bskal pa stong phrag brgyad cu ru// longs spyod che zhing nor yang mang*// zhes sogs sbyin pa'i phan yon rgya che zhing de las kyang tshul khrims bsrung ba mchog ste/ mdzangs blun las/ gang zhig rab tu byung ba de'i bsod nams ni shin tu mang ste/ bdag gi bu'am bu mo'am bran khol gang yang rung ba rab tu byung bar gnang ngam/ bdag nyid rab tu byung na de'i bsod nams dpag tu med do// sbyin pa'i bsod nams ni zad mtha' yod kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rab tu byung ba'i bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bar du bsod nams zad mi shes so// zhes gsungs/ rab tu byung nas tshul khrims srung ba'i phan yon ni brjod las 'das shing*/ de'ang sngon bstan pa ma nyams pa'i skabs bslab gzhi rdzogs pa lo du mar bsrungs shing sems rnam par grol ba las kyang*/ bstan pa nub pa deng sang lta bur bslab pa sne gcig tsam mam/

sems kyi nyon mongs cung zad re bcom nus na phan yon che bar gsungs te/ ting rgyal las kyang*/ bskal pa bye ba gaṅgā'i bye snyed du// dang ba'i sems kyis zas dang skom rnams dang*// gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i phreng ba yis// sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gro byas// gang zhig dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang*// bde gshegs bstan pa 'gag par gyur pa'i tshe// nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa// de ni de las bsod nams khyad par 'phags// zhes pa ltar phan yon che rung deng sang gi rab byung phal mo che sdom pa la nan tan mi byed pas ngan 'gror 'gro zhing*/ khyim pa rnams dad pa'i sems kyis lhar skye ba sogs snying rje pad dkar las rgyas par gsungs te/ kun dga' bo/ de na khyim pa gang dag 'chi ba'i dus byed pa de dag 'chi ba'i dus byas ma thag tu phal cher dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris su skye bar 'gyur ro// rab tu byung ba gang dag 'chi ba'i dus byed pa de dag ni phal cher log par ltung bar 'gyur ro// de'i ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag yo byad bsnyungs pa la mi gnas shing sdom pa la mi gnas pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'i lung don 'di la skyi za bas 'dun pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bag yod pa ste gnas gsum la tha na chu tshod re yang slob pa ci nas gal che zhing*/ yang mdo de las/ phyi ma'i dus dam pa'i chos zad par 'gyur ba na gang dag nga'i bstan pa la rab tu byung nas bu'i lag nas bzung ste chang skyog gang gi phyir chang ma'i khyim du 'khyam la/ nga'i chos kyi rjes su slob pa de dag thams cad kyang bskal pa bzang po 'di la yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro// zhes rgyal ba nyid kyi smon lam gyi mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pas 'brel tshad don ldan gyi tshul de lta lags na/ bstan pa la zhugs nas bslab pa nyin gcig tsam bsrung ba'ang don chen po'o// de bzhin tu/ yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la cung zad 'brel pa'i dge rtsa yang bsam gyis mi khyab ste/

sku gzugs le'ur/ mtshams med pa lnga byas su zin kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la dad pa rnyed de sku gzugs byas na las des sems can dmyal ba myong ba'ang chung ngu myong ste theg pa gsum gang yang rung bas nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ bsam pa dag na rgyu yang rab rin po che/ tha ma 'jim pa'am rtsig ngos la sen mos bris pa tshun khyad med tshul mdo de dang*/ dam chos pad dkar las rgyas par gsungs te/ byis pa rtsed mor dga' dang de dag tu// gang gis rgyal ba de phyir mchod rten dag /bye ma las ni phung po byas pa yis// de dag gis kyang byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes dang*// ro nye dang ni lcags sam sa la'ang rung*// bde gshegs rnams kyi sku gzugs byas pa dang*// gang dag la la de na slob pa'i tshe// rtsed mo'i phyir dang gsang ba byed pa na// rtsig ngos shing bu sen mos gzugs bris pa// de dag thams cad byang chub thob 'gyur te// de dag thams cad snying rje can tu 'gyur// de dag thams cad srog chags bye ba sgrol// zhes sogs dang*/ rmad du byung dang khang brtsegs mdo gnyis kar/ stong gsum gyi khams rin po che sna bdun gyi rang bzhin tu byas te phyogs bzhi'i nyan thos dang rang rgyal rnams la phul ba bas/ sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten tha na 'jim pa la skyu ru ra tsam byed cing srog shing khab tsam btsugs pa dang*/ sku gzugs nas 'bru tsam la ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam btsug pas bsod nams che bar gsungs shing*/ ring bsrel ni gzungs chen sde lnga'i shog dril la sogs pa'ang yin zhing*/ gsung rten glegs bam bzhengs pa'i phan yon kyang gsung rab spyi dang sher phyogs las shin tu rgyas pa'i don bsdus/ mdo sdud par/ la las bde gshegs yongs su mya ngan 'das pa yi// mchod rten rin chen bdun las byas shing mchod byed la// bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten de dag gaṅgā yi// bye ma snyed kyi bye ba phrag stong zhing bkang ste// yongs su brtag bzung zhing rnams bye ba mtha' yas na// sems can ji snyed 'khod pa de dag thams cad kyis// las gzhan mi byed lha yi me tog spos rab dang*// byug pas dus gsum bskal pa'am de bas lhag mchod la// gang zhig gang las rnam 'dren stobs bcu 'byung 'gyur ba/

bde bar gshegs kyi yum 'di glegs bam la bris te// 'chang zhing me tog byug pas bsti stang byed gyur na// mchod rten byas mchod bsod nams des ni char mi phod// ces dang*/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed zhing rnams na// sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom nyid btul bas// gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin 'di yig bris te// sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags// zhes sogs 'byung zhing*/ dar cog /'khor lo/ rdo 'bum sogs kyang 'di'i khong du bsdu'o// de dag la mchod bstod bsnyen bkur bgyis pa'i phan yon kyang shin tu rgya chen gsungs la/ mdor bsdus pad dkar du/ bde gshegs mchod rten la ni cung zad cig /mchod phyir sil snyan brdung pa'i sgra phyung ngam// me tog gcig tsam gyis ni mchod pa dang*// bde gshegs sku ni rtsig ngos bris pa la// 'khrugs bzhin pa yis sems kyis bltas na yang*// de dag rim gyis sangs rgyas bye ba mthong*// mchod rten de la gang gis thal mo sbyar// yang na mgo bo skad cig btud pa dang*// g.yeng ba'i sems kyis sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal zhes// tshig ni lan 'ga' brjod par byas na yang*// de dag kun gyis byang chub mchog 'di thob// ces dang*/ snying rje pad dkar las kyang de mtshungs mang du gsungs shing*/ 'di ltar/ nga'i phyir mchod rten byas pa la bsti stang byed pa lta zhog /gang dag sangs rgyas la dmigs nas tha na me tog gcig nam mkha' la 'thor na/ dge ba de yi 'bras bus mya ngan las 'das par nga smra'o// zhes dang*/ sems can mya ngan las 'das pa'i skal pa med pa zhig gis sangs rgyas la dmigs te me tog gcig nam mkha' la 'dor ba dang*/ tha na dud 'gro zhig gis kyang sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dran pa skad cig rnyed na de'ang byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba dang*/ yang*/ gang la la nga rjes su dran nas chos kyi shugs kyis mchi ma phyung ba'am/

spu zing zhes byed pa'am/ shugs ring 'byin pa de dag ni nam yang dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang*/ log par ltung ba thams cad du mi 'gro'o// zhes dang*/ mtha' 'khob dad pa med pa'i mi rnams kyis rgyal ba'i sku dang mchod rten mthong nas sems cung zad dga' ba'ang byang chub tu 'gro ba sogs tshad med par gsungs la/ khyad par phyag byas pas rang lus 'og tu chud pa'i sa'i rdul gyi grangs mnyam 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob nas mthar mya ngan 'da' ba sogs dang*/ bskor ba la'ang phan yon de bzhin tu gsungs te/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdor/ 'jig rten mgon gyi mchod rten la// mi gang bskor ba byed pa yi// bsngags pa bskal pa bye bar yang*// brjod pas zad par bya mi nus// gang zhig sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong la// bskal pa bye bar bsam yas bsti stang byas pa bas// gang zhig phyi dus mi zad bskal pa 'di la ni// mchod rten phyag 'tshal de yi bsod nams ches mang ngo*// zhes sogs dang*/ mar me'i phan yon kyang*/ de las/ gal te khrag khrig brgya stong sangs rgyas zhing*// yungs 'bru dag gis phyur bur gang gyur pa// bgrang ba dang ni gzhal zhing brjod par nus// bde gshegs mar me gcig phul de lta min/ zhes dang*/ mar me 'bul ba'i mdor yang*// tha na srin bu'i 'od tsam gyi mar mes mchod rten gyi bang rim gcig snang bas kyang ye shes kyi phung po rdzogs pa sogs rgya cher 'byung la/ de bzhin tu/ las rnam 'byed las/ dkon mchog gi rten la thal mo sbyar ba/ phyag 'tshal ba/ phyag dar byas pa/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab na bza' sil snyan sogs phul ba la re re bzhin gnas skabs mthar thug gi phan yon ches che ba bcu bcu gsungs shing*/ dkon mchog ta lar/ sangs rgyas kyi bsngags pa brjod pa/ 'chi khar sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro zhing sku gzugs bstan pa sogs kyi phan yon kyang du ma 'byung ngo*// de yang sangs rgyas mngon sum bzhugs pa la mchod pa dang*/

da lta mchod rten nam sems kyis sangs rgyas dmigs nas mchod pa gnyis bsod nams la khyad par cung zad kyang med pa me tog brtsegs pa'i mdo dang*/ myang 'das chen por yang gsungs te/ dga' bo sangs rgyas mngon sum du bzhugs sam/ mya ngan las 'das kyang rung*/ gang gis dad pa'i sems kyis bsti stang dang bcas pas phyag 'tshal te mchod pa byas na/ skyes bu de gnyis kyis bsod nams thob pa ni gnyis su byar med par rigs par bya'o// zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang rin po che phung po'i mdor/ stong gsum gyi sems can thams cad 'khor los sgyur rgyal sha stag tu gyur la/ de re res kyang rgya mtsho'i mar khu/ ri rab kyi sdong bu byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la mar me 'bul ba bas/ khyim nas rab tu byung ba'i sdom ldan zhig gis yungs 'bru tsam gyis bskus pa'i mar me'i sdong bu phul ba dang*/ yang*/ 'khor los sgyur ba de dag re res 'dzam bu'i gling thams cad me tog gis bkang ste 'bul ba bas/ rab tu byung bas me tog gcig phul na bsod nams de la bsod nams snga ma des brgya yi cha/ stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro ba nas/ rgyu'i bar du yang mi bzod do// zhes dang*/ de las kyang byang chub sems kyis zin pa dang*/ dmigs med kyis zin pa gong nas gong du phan yon che ste/ me tog brtsegs par/ gang zhig de bzhin gshegs pa la lo stong phrag tshang ba bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyis bkur sti byas pa bas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mchod rten la byang sems kyi zin nas me tog gam/ spos sam/ mar me gcig tsam mam/ chu snyim pa gang 'thor nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes smras na de ni bskal pa brgya stong du yang ngan 'gro log par ltung ba'i gnas med do// zhes dang*/ rin po che phung po'i mdor/ srid pa gsum gyi sems can de dag re res mchod rten ri rab tsam re re byed la/
